  match t with
  | atom n => square_atom n
  | arr u v => arr (square_term u) (square_term v)
  end.

Lemma substitute_substitute : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute g (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => substitute g (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f g t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_square_term : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute f (square_term t) = substitute (fun n => arr (f n) (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_ext : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> substitute f t = substitute g t.
Proof.
  intros f g t H; induction t; simpl; [apply H|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma square_term_arr : forall (u : term), exists a b, square_term u = arr a b.
Proof.
  intros u; destruct u; simpl.
  - exists (atom n), (atom n); reflexivity.
  - exists (square_term u1), (square_term u2); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_inj : forall (t u : term), square_term t = square_term u -> t = u.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | t1 IH1 t2 IH2]; intros [m | u v] H; simpl in H.
  - injection H as H1 _. subst. reflexivity.
  - destruct (square_term_arr u) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite <- H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - destruct (square_term_arr t1) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - injection H as H1 H2. subst.
    rewrite (IH1 u H1), (IH2 v H2). reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma square_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  square_term (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => square_term (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_as_subst : forall (t : term),
  square_term t = substitute (fun n => arr (atom n) (atom n)) t.
Proof.
  intros t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.


(* --- Shifting a solution (renaming all image atoms up by one) --- *)

Definition shift_term (t : term) : term := substitute (fun n => atom (S n)) t.
Definition shift_val (f : valuation) : valuation := fun n => shift_term (f n).
Definition up_val (g : valuation) : valuation :=
  fun n => match n with 0 => atom 0 | S k => shift_term (g k) end.

Lemma shift_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  shift_term (substitute f t) = substitute (shift_val f) t.
Proof.
  intros f t. unfold shift_term, shift_val. rewrite substitute_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_up_shift : forall (g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute (up_val g) (shift_term t) = shift_term (substitute g t).
Proof.
  intros g t. unfold shift_term.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  apply substitute_ext; intro n.
  unfold up_val. simpl. unfold shift_term. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_solution : forall (phi psi0 psi1 : valuation) (s t0 t1 : term),
  substitute psi0 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t0 ->
  substitute psi1 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t1 ->
  substitute (up_val psi0) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t0 /\
  substitute (up_val psi1) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t1.
Proof.
  intros phi psi0 psi1 s t0 t1 H0 H1. split.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H0.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H1.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Basic System F typing of combinators --- *)

Lemma type_assignment_I : forall (Gamma : environment) (s : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_var 0)) (poly_arr s s).
Proof.
  intros Gamma s.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_K : forall (Gamma : environment) (a b : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_abs (pure_var 1))) (poly_arr a (poly_arr b a)).
Proof.
  intros Gamma a b.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Type-level renaming lemmas --- *)

Lemma ren_poly_type_ext : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  (forall n, xi n = xj n) -> ren_poly_type xi T = ren_poly_type xj T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj H; simpl.
  - now rewrite H.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj H), (IHb xi xj H).
  - f_equal.
    assert (Hup : forall n, scons 0 (funcomp S xi) n = scons 0 (funcomp S xj) n).
    { intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|]; unfold funcomp; simpl; now rewrite H. }
    rewrite (IHc _ _ Hup). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_poly_type_comp : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  ren_poly_type xi (ren_poly_type xj T) =
  ren_poly_type (fun n => xi (xj n)) T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj), (IHb xi xj).
  - f_equal.
    rewrite (IHc (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons 0 (funcomp S xj))).
    apply ren_poly_type_ext. intro n. destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity|].
    unfold funcomp; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith PeanoNat.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction.

(* ---------- Substitution identity ---------- *)
Lemma substitute_id : forall (t : term),
  substitute (fun n => atom n) t = t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma substitute_arr : forall (f : valuation) (a b : term),
  substitute f (arr a b) = arr (substitute f a) (substitute f b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* If s is an atom, LU2SemiU is always solvable. *)
Lemma LU2SemiU_atom : forall (n : nat) (t0 t1 : term),
  LU2SemiU (atom n, t0, t1).
Proof.
  intros n t0 t1.
  exists (fun m => atom m).
  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t0 | right _ => atom m end).
  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t1 | right _ => atom m end).
  split.
  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- Occurs-check instance is unsolvable ---------- *)

Lemma no_self_arrow : forall (psi : valuation) (x : term),
  x <> arr (substitute psi x) (substitute psi x).
Proof.
  intros psi x. induction x as [n | a IHa b IHb]; simpl in *.
  - discriminate.
  - intro H. injection H as H1 H2.
    assert (Heq : a = b) by (rewrite H1, H2; reflexivity).
    subst b.
    apply (IHa).
    rewrite <- H1.
    rewrite substitute_arr.
    rewrite H1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma occurs_unsolvable :
  ~ LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 0), atom 0, atom 0).
Proof.
  intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]].
  simpl in H0.
  rewrite substitute_arr in H0.
  (* H0 : arr (substitute psi0 (phi 0)) (substitute psi0 (phi 0)) = phi 0 *)
  apply (no_self_arrow psi0 (phi 0)).
  rewrite <- H0. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- An instance that is solvable but NOT with phi mapping atoms to atoms ---------- *)

Definition phi_arrow : valuation := fun n =>
  match n with
  | 0 => atom 0
  | 1 => atom 1
  | 2 => arr (atom 0) (atom 1)
  | S (S (S k)) => atom (S (S (S k)))
  end.

Lemma solvable_arrow_image :
  LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 1), atom 2, atom 2).
Proof.
  exists phi_arrow, (fun n => atom n), (fun n => atom n).
  split.
  - unfold phi_arrow. simpl. now rewrite !substitute_id.
  - unfold phi_arrow. simpl. now rewrite !substitute_id.
Qed.

(* No renaming-only solution: if phi maps every atom to an atom, impossible. *)
Lemma no_renaming_solution :
  ~ (exists (g : nat -> nat) (psi0 psi1 : valuation),
       (forall n, phi_arrow n = atom (g n)) /\
       substitute psi0 (substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (arr (atom 0) (atom 1)))
         = substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (atom 2) /\
       substitute psi1 (substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (arr (atom 0) (atom 1)))
         = substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (atom 2)).
Proof.
  intros [g [psi0 [psi1 [_ [H0 _]]]]].
  simpl in H0. rewrite substitute_arr in H0.
  rewrite <- H0. discriminate.
Qed.

(* Matching reformulation of LU2SemiU (fact 2). *)
Lemma LU2SemiU_matching :
  forall p,
  LU2SemiU p <->
  (exists phi,
     (exists psi0, substitute psi0 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd (fst p))) /\
     (exists psi1, substitute psi1 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd p))).
Proof.
  intros [[s t0] t1]. simpl.
  split.
  - intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]]. exists phi. split; eauto.
  - intros [phi [[psi0 H0] [psi1 H1]]]. exists phi, psi0, psi1.
    auto.
Qed.
V

(* ---------- The polymorphic escape, verified in Coq ---------- *)

(* λx. x x is typable at (∀a.a) → b  for an arbitrary free b. *)
Lemma type_assignment_xx :
  type_assignment []
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)))
    (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)).
Proof.
  apply type_assignment_abs with (s := poly_abs (poly_var 0)).
  eapply type_assignment_app with (s := poly_abs (poly_var 0)).
  - (* x used as a function, instantiated to (∀a.a) → b *)
    eapply type_assignment_inst with (s := poly_var 0) (t := arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)).
    apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
  - (* x used as an argument at type ∀a.a *)
    apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Application-only terms are typable at ANY type, provided every variable
   is given the polymorphic scheme ∀a.a.  This is the "∀a.a escape". *)
Inductive app_only : pure_term -> Prop :=
| app_only_var (x : nat) : app_only (pure_var x)
| app_only_app (M N : pure_term) : app_only M -> app_only N -> app_only (pure_app M N).

Fixpoint pvar_bound (M : pure_term) : nat :=
  match M with
  | pure_var x => S x
  | pure_app M N => Nat.max (pvar_bound M) (pvar_bound N)
  | pure_abs M => pvar_bound M
  end.

Lemma app_only_typable_aux :
  forall (M : pure_term), app_only M ->
  forall (Gamma : environment) (tau : poly_type) (n : nat),
    pvar_bound M <= n ->
    (forall x, x < n -> nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0))) ->
    type_assignment Gamma M tau.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [x | M N HM IHm HN IHn]; intros Gamma tau n Hb Hl.
  - apply type_assignment_inst with (s := poly_var 0) (t := tau).
    apply type_assignment_var.
    apply Hl. unfold pvar_bound in Hb. lia.
  - simpl in Hb. apply Nat.max_lub in Hb as [Hb1 Hb2].
    eapply type_assignment_app with (s := tau).
    + apply IHm. exact Hb1. exact Hl.
    + apply IHn. exact Hb2. exact Hl.
Qed.

(* Concrete corollary: a two-variable application-only term is always typable. *)
Lemma app_only_example : forall tau,
  type_assignment (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3)
    (pure_app (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 1)) (pure_var 2)) tau.
Proof.
  intros tau.
  apply app_only_typable_aux with (n := 3).
  - apply app_only_app.
    + apply app_only_app; constructor.
    + constructor.
  - simpl. lia.
  - intros x Hx. rewrite nth_error_repeat. simpl.
    assert (Hx' : x = 0 \/ x = 1 \/ x = 2) by lia. destruct Hx' as [->|[->|->]]; reflexivity.
Qed.

- `substitute_id : forall t, substitute (fun n => atom n) t = t`
- `LU2SemiU_atom : forall n t0 t1, LU2SemiU (atom n, t0, t1)` (if s is an atom the instance is always solvable)
- `occurs_unsolvable : ~ LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 0), atom 0, atom 0)`
  - Proof by infinite descent: any solution gives a term `x` with `x = arr (substitute psi x) (substitute psi x)`, preserved under `x |-> substitute psi x`, contradicting well-foundedness of term size.

- `type_assignment_xx : type_assignment nil (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))) (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1))`
  - The verified form of the ∀a.a escape.
- `app_only_typable_aux`: if `M` is application-only (`app_only`), every variable scheme is `∀a.a`, and `pvar_bound M <= n`, then `type_assignment Gamma M tau` for every `tau`. Hence application-only terms impose no type constraints at all.

## Experiments

`/tmp/wells_scratch/su.py` implements a brute-force solver for LU2SemiU using the exact reformulation: enumerate φ on the finitely many relevant atoms (bounded images), then check by first-order matching whether `φ t0` and `φ t1` are both instances of `φ s`. ## The exact obstruction

The reduction must prove both directions:

- Soundness (`LU2SemiU p -> SysF_TYP (reduce p)`): given φ, ψ0, ψ1, build a type derivation. The supplied `shift_solution` is evidently intended for this direction: it produces a solution whose φ-images avoid atom 0 and whose ψ fixes atom 0, exactly what is needed to avoid de Bruijn capture when descending under a `poly_abs` binder.
- Completeness (`SysF_TYP (reduce p) -> LU2SemiU p`): given a derivation, extract φ, ψ0, ψ1. This is the hard direction and is where every construction I tried failed.

1. **φ-images must be arbitrary compound types.** `(arr a0 a1, a2, a2)` is solvable but has no renaming solution. Therefore a reduction cannot model φ by giving atom-variables type variables; it must realize shared, potentially compound φ-images in both the s-constraint and the t_i-constraints.

2. **Curry F instantiation is prefix-only.** The `inst` rule substitutes only the ∀-prefix of a scheme; free type variables of a scheme (hence environment type variables) are rigid. Semi-unification’s ψ_i substitutes the atoms inside φ(s). If φ(s) is represented with its atoms free, ψ_i cannot act; if represented with its atoms bound, then the same atoms cannot simultaneously occur free in the argument type representing φ(t_i). This bound/free conflict is precisely the Wells/Dudenhefner gadget problem, and none of my direct encodings resolved it.

3. **Polymorphism cannot be structurally excluded.** Every application-only term is typable at every type (`app_only_typable_aux`), and λx.xx is typable, so there is no simple “force the variable to be monomorphic” gadget. Exact type equality is not forceable by the ordinary application/abstraction constraints alone.

4. **`square_term` is not an equivalence on instances** (verified counterexample above), so it cannot be justified by a lemma of the form `LU2SemiU p <-> LU2SemiU (sq p)`; its algebraic lemmas (`substitute_square_term`, `square_term_inj`, `square_term_arr`) must be consumed inside a term gadget whose correctness is the missing piece.

A complete proof would need, at minimum: (i) the explicit computable term `reduce`, (ii) a soundness derivation-building lemma using `shift_solution` under binders, and (iii) a completeness “polymorphic-escape elimination” lemma showing every Curry typing of the constructed term specializes to a LU2SemiU solution with arbitrary φ-images. I was unable to reconstruct or independently verify the term gadget needed for (iii); my attempts either forced the too-strong equality `φ(s) = φ(t_i)` or collapsed because of the prefix-only instantiation described in (2). I am reporting this as an unresolved gap rather than fabricating a plausible-looking construction.

But φ(t_i) as a *type* is being forced by the term's t_i-side; its traversal of the same images would naturally use the same ambient free vars. However, after closing φ(s) under poly_abs^K, those vars become *bound* inside X. The t_i-side type φ(t_i) would have them free, so the two types are not syntactically comparable without shifting. The conflict: X's body's variables are bound, while U_i (the t_i-side type) has them free. But we don't need U_i to be literally an instance of X at the *same indices*; the inst chain maps bound vars to the *ambient* types, which can include the free vars. Specifically, X = ∀^K(φ(s)); insting with ψ's images yields a type whose free variables are the ambient ones (the images' atoms), because inst substitutes bound vars by types containing free vars. So U_i=ψ(φ(s)) does have free ambient variables! The t_i-side type φ(t_i) also has the same free ambient variables. No conflict at the *result* level! The "conflict" is only if one tries to have φ(s) itself both as body and use type; but the use types are both instances, hence both have ambient free vars. So obstruction #2 may be surmountable: the s-side is not a "use" at φ(s), but the *body* of the scheme; the t_i-sides are instances. And the equations require ψ(φs)=φt_i, which is exactly "φt_i is an instance of φs"—so why did we earlier think the φ=id case is insufficient? Because φ is applied to t_i on the RHS too, and t_i may have atoms not in s whose φ-images also need ψ; also φ(t_i) must be an instance of φ(s), which is precisely the equation—so the scheme approach is *exactly* right, provided:
- The scheme body is φ(s) (s-shaped with leaves = ambient types T_a).
- The use types are φ(t_i) (t_i-shaped with the same T_a's).

Because φ(atom) := T_m is the *instantiation*, not the body. The body's arr structure, however, is preserved: the body must be arr at the positions where the instance is arr. If the instance is φ(s) and s=arr(u,v), the body could be an atom var and inst fills it with arr(u)(v)—so the body needn't be s-shaped either! 18	  LU2SemiU (atom n, t0, t1).
19	Proof.
20	  intros n t0 t1.
21	  exists (fun m => atom m).
22	  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t0 | right _ => atom m end).
23	  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t1 | right _ => atom m end).
24	  split.

26	    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
27	    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
28	  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
29	    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].

35	Lemma no_self_arrow : forall (psi : valuation) (x : term),
36	  x <> arr (substitute psi x) (substitute psi x).
37	Proof.
38	  intros psi x. induction x as [n | a IHa b IHb]; simpl in *.
39	  - discriminate.
40	  - intro H. injection H as H1 H2.
41	    assert (Heq : a = b).
42	    { transitivity (arr (substitute psi a) (substitute psi b)).
43	      - exact H1.
44	      - symmetry. exact H2. }
45	    subst b.

93	  LU2SemiU p <->

95	     (exists psi0, substitute psi0 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
96	                   = substitute phi (snd (fst p))) /\
97	     (exists psi1, substitute psi1 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
98	                   = substitute phi (snd p))).
99	Proof.
100	  intros [[s t0] t1]. simpl.
101	  split.
102	  - intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]]. exists phi. split; eauto.
103	  - intros [phi [[psi0 H0] [psi1 H1]]]. exists phi, psi0, psi1.

110	Lemma type_assignment_xx :
111	  type_assignment (@nil poly_type)
112	    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)))
113	    (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)).
114	Proof.
115	  refine (@type_assignment_abs nil
116	            (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))
117	            (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1) _).
118	  refine (@type_assignment_app (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
119	            (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)
120	            (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1) _ _).
121	  - (* x used as a function, instantiated to (∀a.a) → b *)
122	    refine (@type_assignment_inst (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
123	              (pure_var 0) (poly_var 0)
124	              (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)) _).
125	    apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
126	  - (* x used as an argument at type ∀a.a *)
127	    apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
128	Qed.

130	(* Application-only terms are typable at ANY type, provided every variable
131	   is given the polymorphic scheme ∀a.a.  This is the "∀a.a escape". *)
132	Inductive app_only : pure_term -> Prop :=
133	| app_only_var (x : nat) : app_only (pure_var x)
134	| app_only_app (M N : pure_term) : app_only M -> app_only N -> app_only (pure_app M N).
135	
136	Fixpoint pvar_bound (M : pure_term) : nat :=
137	  match M with
138	  | pure_var x => S x
139	  | pure_app M N => Nat.max (pvar_bound M) (pvar_bound N)
140	  | pure_abs M => pvar_bound M
141	  end.
142	
143	Lemma app_only_typable_aux :
144	  forall (M : pure_term), app_only M ->
145	  forall (Gamma : environment) (tau : poly_type) (n : nat),
146	    pvar_bound M <= n ->
147	    (forall x, x < n -> nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0))) ->
148	    type_assignment Gamma M tau.
149	Proof.
150	  induction 1 as [x | M N HM IHm HN IHn]; intros Gamma tau n Hb Hl.
151	  - refine (@type_assignment_inst Gamma (pure_var x) (poly_var 0) tau _).
152	    apply type_assignment_var.
153	    apply Hl. unfold pvar_bound in Hb. lia.
154	  - simpl in Hb.
155	    assert (Hb1 : pvar_bound M <= n) by (eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_l | exact Hb]).
156	    assert (Hb2 : pvar_bound N <= n) by (eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_r | exact Hb]).
157	    refine (@type_assignment_app Gamma M N tau tau _ _).
158	    + apply (IHm Gamma (poly_arr tau tau) n Hb1 Hl).
159	    + apply (IHn Gamma tau n Hb2 Hl).
160	Qed.

163	Lemma app_only_example : forall tau,
164	  type_assignment (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3)
165	    (pure_app (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 1)) (pure_var 2)) tau.
166	Proof.
167	  intros tau.
168	  refine (@app_only_typable_aux _ _ (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3) tau 3 _ _).
169	  - apply app_only_app.
170	    + apply app_only_app; constructor.
171	    + constructor.
172	  - simpl. lia.
173	  - intros x Hx.
174	    destruct x as [|[|[|x]]]; simpl in *; try reflexivity; lia.
175	Qed.

210	          arr (arr (phi 0) (phi 0))

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith PeanoNat.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction.

(* ---------- Substitution identity ---------- *)
Lemma substitute_id : forall (t : term),
  substitute (fun n => atom n) t = t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma substitute_arr : forall (f : valuation) (a b : term),
  substitute f (arr a b) = arr (substitute f a) (substitute f b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* If s is an atom, LU2SemiU is always solvable. *)
Lemma LU2SemiU_atom : forall (n : nat) (t0 t1 : term),
  LU2SemiU (atom n, t0, t1).
Proof.
  intros n t0 t1.
  exists (fun m => atom m).
  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t0 | right _ => atom m end).
  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t1 | right _ => atom m end).
  split.
  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- Occurs-check instance is unsolvable ---------- *)

Lemma no_self_arrow : forall (psi : valuation) (x : term),
  x <> arr (substitute psi x) (substitute psi x).
Proof.
  intros psi x. induction x as [n | a IHa b IHb]; simpl in *.
  - discriminate.
  - intro H. injection H as H1 H2.
    assert (Heq : a = b).
    { transitivity (arr (substitute psi a) (substitute psi b)).
      - exact H1.
      - symmetry. exact H2. }
    subst b.
    apply (IHa).
    exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma occurs_unsolvable :
  ~ LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 0), atom 0, atom 0).
Proof.
  intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]].
  simpl in H0.
  (* H0 : arr (substitute psi0 (phi 0)) (substitute psi0 (phi 0)) = phi 0 *)
  apply (no_self_arrow psi0 (phi 0)).
  symmetry. exact H0.
Qed.

(* ---------- An instance that is solvable but NOT with phi mapping atoms to atoms ---------- *)

Definition phi_arrow : valuation := fun n =>
  match n with
  | 0 => atom 0
  | 1 => atom 1
  | 2 => arr (atom 0) (atom 1)
  | S (S (S k)) => atom (S (S (S k)))
  end.

Lemma solvable_arrow_image :
  LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 1), atom 2, atom 2).
Proof.
  exists phi_arrow, (fun n => atom n), (fun n => atom n).
  split.
  - unfold phi_arrow. cbn. reflexivity.
  - unfold phi_arrow. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* No renaming-only solution: if phi maps every atom to an atom (phi n = atom (g n)),
   then even the FIRST inequality is impossible, because its left side is an arrow
   while its right side is an atom. *)
Lemma no_renaming_solution :
  forall (g : nat -> nat) (psi0 : valuation),
    substitute psi0 (substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (arr (atom 0) (atom 1)))
    <> substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (atom 2).
Proof.
  intros g psi0. simpl. discriminate.
Qed.

(* Matching reformulation of LU2SemiU (fact 2). *)
Lemma LU2SemiU_matching :
  forall p,
  LU2SemiU p <->
  (exists phi,
     (exists psi0, substitute psi0 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd (fst p))) /\
     (exists psi1, substitute psi1 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd p))).
Proof.
  intros [[s t0] t1]. simpl.
  split.
  - intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]]. exists phi. split; eauto.
  - intros [phi [[psi0 H0] [psi1 H1]]]. exists phi, psi0, psi1.
    auto.
Qed.

  type_assignment (@nil poly_type)
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)))
    (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)).
Proof.
  refine (@type_assignment_abs nil
            (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))
            (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1) _).
  refine (@type_assignment_app (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
            (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)
            (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1) _ _).
  - (* x used as a function, instantiated to (∀a.a) → b *)
    refine (@type_assignment_inst (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
              (pure_var 0) (poly_var 0)
              (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)) _).
    apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
  - (* x used as an argument at type ∀a.a *)
    apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Application-only terms are typable at ANY type, provided every variable
   is given the polymorphic scheme ∀a.a.  This is the "∀a.a escape". *)
Inductive app_only : pure_term -> Prop :=
| app_only_var (x : nat) : app_only (pure_var x)
| app_only_app (M N : pure_term) : app_only M -> app_only N -> app_only (pure_app M N).

Fixpoint pvar_bound (M : pure_term) : nat :=
  match M with
  | pure_var x => S x
  | pure_app M N => Nat.max (pvar_bound M) (pvar_bound N)
  | pure_abs M => pvar_bound M
  end.

Lemma app_only_typable_aux :
  forall (M : pure_term), app_only M ->
  forall (Gamma : environment) (tau : poly_type) (n : nat),
    pvar_bound M <= n ->
    (forall x, x < n -> nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0))) ->
    type_assignment Gamma M tau.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [x | M N HM IHm HN IHn]; intros Gamma tau n Hb Hl.
  - refine (@type_assignment_inst Gamma (pure_var x) (poly_var 0) tau _).
    apply type_assignment_var.
    apply Hl. unfold pvar_bound in Hb. lia.
  - simpl in Hb.
    assert (Hb1 : pvar_bound M <= n) by (eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_l | exact Hb]).
    assert (Hb2 : pvar_bound N <= n) by (eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_r | exact Hb]).
    refine (@type_assignment_app Gamma M N tau tau _ _).
    + apply (IHm Gamma (poly_arr tau tau) n Hb1 Hl).
    + apply (IHn Gamma tau n Hb2 Hl).
Qed.

Lemma app_only_example : forall tau,
  type_assignment (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3)
    (pure_app (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 1)) (pure_var 2)) tau.
Proof.
  intros tau.
  refine (@app_only_typable_aux _ _ (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3) tau 3 _ _).
  - apply app_only_app.
    + apply app_only_app; constructor.
    + constructor.
  - simpl. lia.
  - intros x Hx.
    destruct x as [|[|[|x]]]; simpl in *; try reflexivity; lia.
Qed.

(* --- Auxiliary semi-unification substitution lemmas --- *)

Definition square_atom (n : nat) : term := arr (atom n) (atom n).

Fixpoint square_term (t : term) : term :=
  match t with
  | atom n => square_atom n
  | arr u v => arr (square_term u) (square_term v)
  end.

Lemma substitute_substitute : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute g (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => substitute g (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f g t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_square_term : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute f (square_term t) = substitute (fun n => arr (f n) (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_ext : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> substitute f t = substitute g t.
Proof.
  intros f g t H; induction t; simpl; [apply H|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma square_term_arr : forall (u : term), exists a b, square_term u = arr a b.
Proof.
  intros u; destruct u; simpl.
  - exists (atom n), (atom n); reflexivity.
  - exists (square_term u1), (square_term u2); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_inj : forall (t u : term), square_term t = square_term u -> t = u.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | t1 IH1 t2 IH2]; intros [m | u v] H; simpl in H.
  - injection H as H1 _. subst. reflexivity.
  - destruct (square_term_arr u) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite <- H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - destruct (square_term_arr t1) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - injection H as H1 H2. subst.
    rewrite (IH1 u H1), (IH2 v H2). reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma square_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  square_term (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => square_term (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_as_subst : forall (t : term),
  square_term t = substitute (fun n => arr (atom n) (atom n)) t.
Proof.
  intros t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.


(* --- Shifting a solution (renaming all image atoms up by one) --- *)

Definition shift_term (t : term) : term := substitute (fun n => atom (S n)) t.
Definition shift_val (f : valuation) : valuation := fun n => shift_term (f n).
Definition up_val (g : valuation) : valuation :=
  fun n => match n with 0 => atom 0 | S k => shift_term (g k) end.

Lemma shift_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  shift_term (substitute f t) = substitute (shift_val f) t.
Proof.
  intros f t. unfold shift_term, shift_val. rewrite substitute_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_up_shift : forall (g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute (up_val g) (shift_term t) = shift_term (substitute g t).
Proof.
  intros g t. unfold shift_term.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  apply substitute_ext; intro n.
  unfold up_val. simpl. unfold shift_term. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_solution : forall (phi psi0 psi1 : valuation) (s t0 t1 : term),
  substitute psi0 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t0 ->
  substitute psi1 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t1 ->
  substitute (up_val psi0) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t0 /\
  substitute (up_val psi1) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t1.
Proof.
  intros phi psi0 psi1 s t0 t1 H0 H1. split.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H0.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H1.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_I : forall (Gamma : environment) (s : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_var 0)) (poly_arr s s).
Proof.
  intros Gamma s.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_K : forall (Gamma : environment) (a b : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_abs (pure_var 1))) (poly_arr a (poly_arr b a)).
Proof.
  intros Gamma a b.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_poly_type_ext : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  (forall n, xi n = xj n) -> ren_poly_type xi T = ren_poly_type xj T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj H; simpl.
  - now rewrite H.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj H), (IHb xi xj H).
  - f_equal.
    assert (Hup : forall n, scons 0 (funcomp S xi) n = scons 0 (funcomp S xj) n).
    { intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|]; unfold funcomp; simpl; now rewrite H. }
    rewrite (IHc _ _ Hup). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_poly_type_comp : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  ren_poly_type xi (ren_poly_type xj T) =
  ren_poly_type (fun n => xi (xj n)) T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj), (IHb xi xj).
  - f_equal.
    rewrite (IHc (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons 0 (funcomp S xj))).
    apply ren_poly_type_ext. intro n. destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity|].
    unfold funcomp; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* --- Bridge between term-level and type-level syntax --- *)

Fixpoint encode_term (t : term) : poly_type :=
  match t with
  | atom n => poly_var n
  | arr s t => poly_arr (encode_term s) (encode_term t)
  end.

Lemma encode_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute f t) =
  subst_poly_type (fun n => encode_term (f n)) (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma encode_ren : forall (xi : nat -> nat) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute (fun n => atom (xi n)) t) =
  ren_poly_type xi (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intros xi t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma encode_shift : forall (t : term),
  encode_term (shift_term t) = ren_poly_type S (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intro t. unfold shift_term. apply encode_ren.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction.

(* --- Auxiliary semi-unification substitution lemmas --- *)

Definition square_atom (n : nat) : term := arr (atom n) (atom n).

Fixpoint square_term (t : term) : term :=
  match t with
  | atom n => square_atom n
  | arr u v => arr (square_term u) (square_term v)
  end.

Lemma substitute_substitute : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute g (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => substitute g (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f g t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_square_term : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute f (square_term t) = substitute (fun n => arr (f n) (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_ext : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> substitute f t = substitute g t.
Proof.
  intros f g t H; induction t; simpl; [apply H|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma square_term_arr : forall (u : term), exists a b, square_term u = arr a b.
Proof.
  intros u; destruct u; simpl.
  - exists (atom n), (atom n); reflexivity.
  - exists (square_term u1), (square_term u2); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_inj : forall (t u : term), square_term t = square_term u -> t = u.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | t1 IH1 t2 IH2]; intros [m | u v] H; simpl in H.
  - injection H as H1 _. subst. reflexivity.
  - destruct (square_term_arr u) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite <- H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - destruct (square_term_arr t1) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - injection H as H1 H2. subst.
    rewrite (IH1 u H1), (IH2 v H2). reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma square_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  square_term (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => square_term (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_as_subst : forall (t : term),
  square_term t = substitute (fun n => arr (atom n) (atom n)) t.
Proof.
  intros t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.


(* --- Shifting a solution (renaming all image atoms up by one) --- *)

Definition shift_term (t : term) : term := substitute (fun n => atom (S n)) t.
Definition shift_val (f : valuation) : valuation := fun n => shift_term (f n).
Definition up_val (g : valuation) : valuation :=
  fun n => match n with 0 => atom 0 | S k => shift_term (g k) end.

Lemma shift_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  shift_term (substitute f t) = substitute (shift_val f) t.
Proof.
  intros f t. unfold shift_term, shift_val. rewrite substitute_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_up_shift : forall (g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute (up_val g) (shift_term t) = shift_term (substitute g t).
Proof.
  intros g t. unfold shift_term.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  apply substitute_ext; intro n.
  unfold up_val. simpl. unfold shift_term. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_solution : forall (phi psi0 psi1 : valuation) (s t0 t1 : term),
  substitute psi0 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t0 ->
  substitute psi1 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t1 ->
  substitute (up_val psi0) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t0 /\
  substitute (up_val psi1) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t1.
Proof.
  intros phi psi0 psi1 s t0 t1 H0 H1. split.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H0.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H1.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Basic System F typing of combinators --- *)

Lemma type_assignment_I : forall (Gamma : environment) (s : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_var 0)) (poly_arr s s).
Proof.
  intros Gamma s.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_K : forall (Gamma : environment) (a b : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_abs (pure_var 1))) (poly_arr a (poly_arr b a)).
Proof.
  intros Gamma a b.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Type-level renaming lemmas --- *)

Lemma ren_poly_type_ext : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  (forall n, xi n = xj n) -> ren_poly_type xi T = ren_poly_type xj T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj H; simpl.
  - now rewrite H.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj H), (IHb xi xj H).
  - f_equal.
    assert (Hup : forall n, scons 0 (funcomp S xi) n = scons 0 (funcomp S xj) n).
    { intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|]; unfold funcomp; simpl; now rewrite H. }
    rewrite (IHc _ _ Hup). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_poly_type_comp : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  ren_poly_type xi (ren_poly_type xj T) =
  ren_poly_type (fun n => xi (xj n)) T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj), (IHb xi xj).
  - f_equal.
    rewrite (IHc (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons 0 (funcomp S xj))).
    apply ren_poly_type_ext. intro n. destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity|].
    unfold funcomp; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* --- Bridge between term-level and type-level syntax --- *)

Fixpoint encode_term (t : term) : poly_type :=
  match t with
  | atom n => poly_var n
  | arr s t => poly_arr (encode_term s) (encode_term t)
  end.

Lemma encode_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute f t) =
  subst_poly_type (fun n => encode_term (f n)) (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma encode_ren : forall (xi : nat -> nat) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute (fun n => atom (xi n)) t) =
  ren_poly_type xi (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intros xi t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma encode_shift : forall (t : term),
  encode_term (shift_term t) = ren_poly_type S (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intro t. unfold shift_term. apply encode_ren.
Qed.

(* --- Target --- *)

Theorem reduction : LU2SemiU ⪯ SysF_TYP.

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction.

(* Insert X into an environment at position k. *)
Fixpoint insert_env (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) : environment :=
  match k with
  | 0 => X :: Gamma
  | S k' =>
      match Gamma with
      | nil => X :: nil
      | Y :: Gamma' => Y :: insert_env k' X Gamma'
      end
  end.

(* Shift free term variables >= k up by one. *)
Fixpoint lift (k : nat) (M : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  match M with
  | pure_var n => pure_var (if n <? k then n else S n)
  | pure_app M N => pure_app (lift k M) (lift k N)
  | pure_abs M => pure_abs (lift (S k) M)
  end.

Lemma nth_error_insert_lt :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> x < k ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) x = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hlt.
  - lia.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + rewrite length_nil in Hlen; lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * reflexivity.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_insert_ge :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> k <= x ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) (S x) = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hge.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + rewrite length_nil in Hlen; lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * lia.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma map_insert_env :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment),
    map (ren_poly_type S) (insert_env k X Gamma) =
    insert_env k (ren_poly_type S X) (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma).
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + now rewrite IH.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_lift :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (tau : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma M tau ->
    forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type),
      type_assignment (insert_env k X Gamma) (lift k M) tau.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M tau H. induction H; intros k X; simpl.
  - apply type_assignment_var.
    destruct (x <? k) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_lt k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_ge k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
  - eapply type_assignment_app; [apply IHtype_assignment1 | apply IHtype_assignment2].
  - apply type_assignment_abs.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment (S k) X).
    exact IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_inst. apply IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_gen.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment k (ren_poly_type S X)).
    rewrite map_insert_env in IHtype_assignment.
    exact IHtype_assignment.
Qed.

(* The gadget: used to force the type of a term to be  A -> B  where
   A is a type of u and B is a type of v. *)
Definition gadget (u v : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                        (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
    (pure_abs (lift 0 v)).

Lemma type_assignment_gadget :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u v : pure_term) (A B : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma u A ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (gadget u v) (poly_arr A B).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u v A B Hu Hv. unfold gadget.
  assert (Harg : type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (lift 0 v)) (poly_arr A B)).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma v B Hv 0 A). }
  assert (Hfun :
    type_assignment Gamma
      (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                          (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
      (poly_arr (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B))).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    simpl.
    (* env: (A->B) :: Gamma ; prove (app (abs (var1)) (app (var0) (lift0 u))) : A->B *)
    eapply type_assignment_app
      with (s := B) (t := poly_arr A B).
    - (* (abs (var 1)) : B -> (A -> B) *)
      apply type_assignment_abs.
      apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
    - (* (app (var 0) (lift 0 u)) : B *)
      eapply type_assignment_app with (s := A) (t := B).
      + apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
      + exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma u A Hu 0 (poly_arr A B)).
  }
  eapply type_assignment_app with (s := poly_arr A B) (t := poly_arr A B).
  - exact Hfun.
  - exact Harg.
Qed.

(* Sanity: the gadget's type is exactly (A -> B) when u : A and v : B. *)
Check type_assignment_gadget.
EOF

(* --- Environment insertion and term lifting --- *)

Fixpoint insert_env (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) : environment :=
  match k with
  | 0 => X :: Gamma
  | S k' =>
      match Gamma with
      | nil => X :: nil
      | Y :: Gamma' => Y :: insert_env k' X Gamma'
      end
  end.

Fixpoint lift (k : nat) (M : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  match M with
  | pure_var n => pure_var (if n <? k then n else S n)
  | pure_app M N => pure_app (lift k M) (lift k N)
  | pure_abs M => pure_abs (lift (S k) M)
  end.

Lemma nth_error_insert_lt :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> x < k ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) x = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hlt.
  - lia.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * reflexivity.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_insert_ge :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> k <= x ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) (S x) = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hge.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * lia.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma map_insert_env :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment),
    map (ren_poly_type S) (insert_env k X Gamma) =
    insert_env k (ren_poly_type S X) (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma).
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + now rewrite IH.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_lift :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (tau : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma M tau ->
    forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type),
      type_assignment (insert_env k X Gamma) (lift k M) tau.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M tau H. induction H; intros k X; simpl.
  - apply type_assignment_var.
    destruct (x <? k) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_lt k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_ge k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
  - eapply type_assignment_app; [apply IHtype_assignment1 | apply IHtype_assignment2].
  - apply type_assignment_abs.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment (S k) X).
    exact IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_inst. apply IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_gen.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment k (ren_poly_type S X)).
    rewrite map_insert_env.
    exact IHtype_assignment.
Qed.

(* --- A gadget whose type is forced to be the arrow of two subterm types --- *)

Definition gadget (u v : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                        (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
    (pure_abs (lift 0 v)).

Lemma type_assignment_gadget :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u v : pure_term) (A B : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma u A ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (gadget u v) (poly_arr A B).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u v A B Hu Hv. unfold gadget.
  assert (Harg : type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (lift 0 v)) (poly_arr A B)).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma v B Hv 0 A). }
  assert (Hfun :
    type_assignment Gamma
      (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                          (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
      (poly_arr (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B))).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    simpl.
    refine (@type_assignment_app ((poly_arr A B) :: Gamma)
              (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
              (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))
              B (poly_arr A B) _ _).
    - apply type_assignment_abs.
      apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
    - refine (@type_assignment_app ((poly_arr A B) :: Gamma)
                (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u) A B _ _).
      + apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
      + exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma u A Hu 0 (poly_arr A B)).
  }
  refine (@type_assignment_app Gamma
            (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                                (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
            (pure_abs (lift 0 v))
            (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B) _ _).
  - exact Hfun.
  - exact Harg.
Qed.

(* --- Environment insertion and term lifting --- *)

Fixpoint insert_env (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) : environment :=
  match k with
  | 0 => X :: Gamma
  | S k' =>
      match Gamma with
      | nil => X :: nil
      | Y :: Gamma' => Y :: insert_env k' X Gamma'
      end
  end.

Fixpoint lift (k : nat) (M : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  match M with
  | pure_var n => pure_var (if n <? k then n else S n)
  | pure_app M N => pure_app (lift k M) (lift k N)
  | pure_abs M => pure_abs (lift (S k) M)
  end.

Lemma nth_error_insert_lt :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> x < k ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) x = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hlt.
  - lia.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * reflexivity.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_insert_ge :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> k <= x ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) (S x) = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hge.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * lia.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma map_insert_env :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment),
    map (ren_poly_type S) (insert_env k X Gamma) =
    insert_env k (ren_poly_type S X) (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma).
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + now rewrite IH.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_lift :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (tau : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma M tau ->
    forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type),
      type_assignment (insert_env k X Gamma) (lift k M) tau.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M tau H. induction H; intros k X; simpl.
  - apply type_assignment_var.
    destruct (x <? k) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_lt k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_ge k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
  - eapply type_assignment_app; [apply IHtype_assignment1 | apply IHtype_assignment2].
  - apply type_assignment_abs.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment (S k) X).
    exact IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_inst. apply IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_gen.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment k (ren_poly_type S X)).
    rewrite map_insert_env.
    exact IHtype_assignment.
Qed.

(* --- A gadget whose type is forced to be the arrow of two subterm types --- *)

Definition gadget (u v : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                        (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
    (pure_abs (lift 0 v)).

Lemma type_assignment_gadget :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u v : pure_term) (A B : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma u A ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (gadget u v) (poly_arr A B).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u v A B Hu Hv. unfold gadget.
  assert (Harg : type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (lift 0 v)) (poly_arr A B)).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma v B Hv 0 A). }
  assert (Hfun :
    type_assignment Gamma
      (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                          (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
      (poly_arr (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B))).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    simpl.
    refine (@type_assignment_app ((poly_arr A B) :: Gamma)
              (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
              (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))
              B (poly_arr A B) _ _).
    - apply type_assignment_abs.
      apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
    - refine (@type_assignment_app ((poly_arr A B) :: Gamma)
                (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u) A B _ _).
      + apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
      + exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma u A Hu 0 (poly_arr A B)).
  }
  refine (@type_assignment_app Gamma
            (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                                (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
            (pure_abs (lift 0 v))
            (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B) _ _).
  - exact Hfun.
  - exact Harg.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction.

(* --- Auxiliary semi-unification substitution lemmas --- *)

Definition square_atom (n : nat) : term := arr (atom n) (atom n).

Fixpoint square_term (t : term) : term :=
  match t with
  | atom n => square_atom n
  | arr u v => arr (square_term u) (square_term v)
  end.

Lemma substitute_substitute : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute g (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => substitute g (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f g t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_square_term : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute f (square_term t) = substitute (fun n => arr (f n) (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_ext : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> substitute f t = substitute g t.
Proof.
  intros f g t H; induction t; simpl; [apply H|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma square_term_arr : forall (u : term), exists a b, square_term u = arr a b.
Proof.
  intros u; destruct u; simpl.
  - exists (atom n), (atom n); reflexivity.
  - exists (square_term u1), (square_term u2); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_inj : forall (t u : term), square_term t = square_term u -> t = u.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | t1 IH1 t2 IH2]; intros [m | u v] H; simpl in H.
  - injection H as H1 _. subst. reflexivity.
  - destruct (square_term_arr u) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite <- H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - destruct (square_term_arr t1) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - injection H as H1 H2. subst.
    rewrite (IH1 u H1), (IH2 v H2). reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma square_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  square_term (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => square_term (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_as_subst : forall (t : term),
  square_term t = substitute (fun n => arr (atom n) (atom n)) t.
Proof.
  intros t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.


(* --- Shifting a solution (renaming all image atoms up by one) --- *)

Definition shift_term (t : term) : term := substitute (fun n => atom (S n)) t.
Definition shift_val (f : valuation) : valuation := fun n => shift_term (f n).
Definition up_val (g : valuation) : valuation :=
  fun n => match n with 0 => atom 0 | S k => shift_term (g k) end.

Lemma shift_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  shift_term (substitute f t) = substitute (shift_val f) t.
Proof.
  intros f t. unfold shift_term, shift_val. rewrite substitute_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_up_shift : forall (g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute (up_val g) (shift_term t) = shift_term (substitute g t).
Proof.
  intros g t. unfold shift_term.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  apply substitute_ext; intro n.
  unfold up_val. simpl. unfold shift_term. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_solution : forall (phi psi0 psi1 : valuation) (s t0 t1 : term),
  substitute psi0 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t0 ->
  substitute psi1 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t1 ->
  substitute (up_val psi0) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t0 /\
  substitute (up_val psi1) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t1.
Proof.
  intros phi psi0 psi1 s t0 t1 H0 H1. split.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H0.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H1.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Basic System F typing of combinators --- *)

Lemma type_assignment_I : forall (Gamma : environment) (s : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_var 0)) (poly_arr s s).
Proof.
  intros Gamma s.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_K : forall (Gamma : environment) (a b : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_abs (pure_var 1))) (poly_arr a (poly_arr b a)).
Proof.
  intros Gamma a b.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Type-level renaming lemmas --- *)

Lemma ren_poly_type_ext : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  (forall n, xi n = xj n) -> ren_poly_type xi T = ren_poly_type xj T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj H; simpl.
  - now rewrite H.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj H), (IHb xi xj H).
  - f_equal.
    assert (Hup : forall n, scons 0 (funcomp S xi) n = scons 0 (funcomp S xj) n).
    { intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|]; unfold funcomp; simpl; now rewrite H. }
    rewrite (IHc _ _ Hup). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_poly_type_comp : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  ren_poly_type xi (ren_poly_type xj T) =
  ren_poly_type (fun n => xi (xj n)) T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj), (IHb xi xj).
  - f_equal.
    rewrite (IHc (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons 0 (funcomp S xj))).
    apply ren_poly_type_ext. intro n. destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity|].
    unfold funcomp; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* --- Bridge between term-level and type-level syntax --- *)

Fixpoint encode_term (t : term) : poly_type :=
  match t with
  | atom n => poly_var n
  | arr s t => poly_arr (encode_term s) (encode_term t)
  end.

Lemma encode_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute f t) =
  subst_poly_type (fun n => encode_term (f n)) (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma encode_ren : forall (xi : nat -> nat) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute (fun n => atom (xi n)) t) =
  ren_poly_type xi (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intros xi t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma encode_shift : forall (t : term),
  encode_term (shift_term t) = ren_poly_type S (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intro t. unfold shift_term. apply encode_ren.
Qed.

(* --- Facts about LU2SemiU used to analyse the problem --- *)

Lemma substitute_id : forall (t : term),
  substitute (fun n => atom n) t = t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma no_self_arrow : forall (psi : valuation) (x : term),
  x <> arr (substitute psi x) (substitute psi x).
Proof.
  intros psi x. induction x as [n | a IHa b IHb]; simpl in *.
  - discriminate.
  - intro H. injection H as H1 H2.
    assert (Heq : a = b).
    { transitivity (arr (substitute psi a) (substitute psi b)).
      - exact H1.
      - symmetry. exact H2. }
    subst b. apply (IHa). exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma occurs_unsolvable :
  ~ LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 0), atom 0, atom 0).
Proof.
  intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]].
  simpl in H0.
  apply (no_self_arrow psi0 (phi 0)).
  symmetry. exact H0.
Qed.

Lemma LU2SemiU_atom : forall (n : nat) (t0 t1 : term),
  LU2SemiU (atom n, t0, t1).
Proof.
  intros n t0 t1.
  exists (fun m => atom m).
  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t0 | right _ => atom m end).
  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t1 | right _ => atom m end).
  split.
  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma LU2SemiU_matching :
  forall p,
  LU2SemiU p <->
  (exists phi,
     (exists psi0, substitute psi0 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd (fst p))) /\
     (exists psi1, substitute psi1 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd p))).
Proof.
  intros [[s t0] t1]. simpl.
  split.
  - intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]]. exists phi. split; eauto.
  - intros [phi [[psi0 H0] [psi1 H1]]]. exists phi, psi0, psi1. auto.
Qed.

Definition phi_arrow : valuation := fun n =>
  match n with
  | 0 => atom 0
  | 1 => atom 1
  | 2 => arr (atom 0) (atom 1)
  | S (S (S k)) => atom (S (S (S k)))
  end.

Lemma solvable_arrow_image :
  LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 1), atom 2, atom 2).
Proof.
  exists phi_arrow, (fun n => atom n), (fun n => atom n).
  split.
  - unfold phi_arrow. cbn. reflexivity.
  - unfold phi_arrow. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A solution cannot always be taken with phi mapping atoms to atoms. *)
Lemma no_renaming_solution :
  forall (g : nat -> nat) (psi0 : valuation),
    substitute psi0 (substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (arr (atom 0) (atom 1)))
    <> substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (atom 2).
Proof.
  intros g psi0. simpl. discriminate.
Qed.

(* --- The polymorphic escape in the supplied System F rules --- *)

Lemma type_assignment_xx :
  type_assignment (@nil poly_type)
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)))
    (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)).
Proof.
  refine (@type_assignment_abs nil
            (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))
            (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1) _).
  refine (@type_assignment_app (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
            (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)
            (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1) _ _).
  - refine (@type_assignment_inst (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
              (pure_var 0) (poly_var 0)
              (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)) _).
    apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
  - apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Inductive app_only : pure_term -> Prop :=
| app_only_var (x : nat) : app_only (pure_var x)
| app_only_app (M N : pure_term) : app_only M -> app_only N -> app_only (pure_app M N).

Fixpoint pvar_bound (M : pure_term) : nat :=
  match M with
  | pure_var x => S x
  | pure_app M N => Nat.max (pvar_bound M) (pvar_bound N)
  | pure_abs M => pvar_bound M
  end.

Lemma app_only_typable_aux :
  forall (M : pure_term), app_only M ->
  forall (Gamma : environment) (tau : poly_type) (n : nat),
    pvar_bound M <= n ->
    (forall x, x < n -> nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0))) ->
    type_assignment Gamma M tau.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [x | M N HM IHm HN IHn]; intros Gamma tau n Hb Hl.
  - refine (@type_assignment_inst Gamma (pure_var x) (poly_var 0) tau _).
    apply type_assignment_var.
    apply Hl. unfold pvar_bound in Hb. lia.
  - simpl in Hb.
    assert (Hb1 : pvar_bound M <= n) by (eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_l | exact Hb]).
    assert (Hb2 : pvar_bound N <= n) by (eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_r | exact Hb]).
    refine (@type_assignment_app Gamma M N tau tau _ _).
    + apply (IHm Gamma (poly_arr tau tau) n Hb1 Hl).
    + apply (IHn Gamma tau n Hb2 Hl).
Qed.

Lemma app_only_example : forall tau,
  type_assignment (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3)
    (pure_app (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 1)) (pure_var 2)) tau.
Proof.
  intros tau.
  refine (@app_only_typable_aux _ _ (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3) tau 3 _ _).
  - apply app_only_app.
    + apply app_only_app; constructor.
    + constructor.
  - simpl. lia.
  - intros x Hx.
    destruct x as [|[|[|x]]]; simpl in *; try reflexivity; lia.
Qed.

(* --- square_term does not preserve LU2SemiU solvability --- *)

Definition t_ex : term := arr (atom 0) (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)).

Lemma original_ex_solvable : LU2SemiU (atom 1, t_ex, t_ex).
Proof.
  exists (fun n => atom n).
  exists (fun n => match Nat.eq_dec n 1 with left _ => t_ex | right _ => atom n end).
  exists (fun n => match Nat.eq_dec n 1 with left _ => t_ex | right _ => atom n end).
  split.
  - rewrite substitute_id. unfold t_ex. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec 1 1) as [e|e].
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply e. reflexivity.
  - rewrite substitute_id. unfold t_ex. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec 1 1) as [e|e].
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply e. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma squared_ex_unsolvable :
  ~ LU2SemiU (square_term (atom 1), square_term t_ex, square_term t_ex).
Proof.
  intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 _]]]].
  unfold square_term, square_atom, t_ex in H0. simpl in H0.
  injection H0 as H1 H2.
  assert (Hbad : phi 0 = arr (phi 0) (phi 0)).
  { injection (eq_trans (eq_sym H1) H2) as H3 _. exact H3. }
  apply (no_self_arrow (fun n => atom n) (phi 0)).
  rewrite substitute_id. exact Hbad.
Qed.

cat > /tmp/gadget/Encode.v <<'EOF'
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction.
Require Import Gadget.

Fixpoint atoms (u : term) : list nat :=
  match u with
  | atom n => n :: nil
  | arr u v => atoms u ++ atoms v
  end.

Fixpoint enc (T : nat -> poly_type) (u : term) : poly_type :=
  match u with
  | atom n => T n
  | arr u v => poly_arr (enc T u) (enc T v)
  end.

Fixpoint E (u : term) : pure_term :=
  match u with
  | atom n => pure_var n
  | arr u v => gadget (E u) (E v)
  end.

Lemma type_assignment_E :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u : term) (T : nat -> poly_type),
    (forall n, In n (atoms u) -> nth_error Gamma n = Some (T n)) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (E u) (enc T u).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u. induction u as [n | u IHu v IHv]; intros T H.
  - simpl. apply type_assignment_var. apply H. simpl. auto.
  - simpl. apply type_assignment_gadget.
    + apply IHu. intros k Hk. apply H. apply in_app_iff. left. exact Hk.
    + apply IHv. intros k Hk. apply H. apply in_app_iff. right. exact Hk.
Qed.

(* The same encoding is stable under adding more environment entries
   in front, which is what a lambda binding does. *)
Definition T_of (Gamma : environment) (n : nat) : poly_type :=
  match nth_error Gamma n with Some t => t | None => poly_var n end.

Lemma type_assignment_E_env :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u : term),
    (forall n, In n (atoms u) -> n < length Gamma) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (E u) (enc (T_of Gamma) u).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u H.
  apply type_assignment_E.
  intros n Hn.
  unfold T_of.
  destruct (nth_error Gamma n) as [t|] eqn:E'.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply nth_error_None in E'. exfalso. apply (Nat.lt_irrefl n). eapply Nat.lt_le_trans.
    + apply H. exact Hn.
    + exact E'.
Qed.

Check type_assignment_E.
Check type_assignment_E_env.
EOF

(* --- Encoding semi-unification terms as System F types via the gadget --- *)

Fixpoint atoms (u : term) : list nat :=
  match u with
  | atom n => n :: nil
  | arr u v => atoms u ++ atoms v
  end.

Fixpoint enc (T : nat -> poly_type) (u : term) : poly_type :=
  match u with
  | atom n => T n
  | arr u v => poly_arr (enc T u) (enc T v)
  end.

Fixpoint E (u : term) : pure_term :=
  match u with
  | atom n => pure_var n
  | arr u v => gadget (E u) (E v)
  end.

Lemma type_assignment_E :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u : term) (T : nat -> poly_type),
    (forall n, In n (atoms u) -> nth_error Gamma n = Some (T n)) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (E u) (enc T u).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u. induction u as [n | u IHu v IHv]; intros T H.
  - simpl. apply type_assignment_var. apply H. simpl. auto.
  - simpl. apply type_assignment_gadget.
    + apply IHu. intros k Hk. apply H. apply in_app_iff. left. exact Hk.
    + apply IHv. intros k Hk. apply H. apply in_app_iff. right. exact Hk.
Qed.

Definition T_of (Gamma : environment) (n : nat) : poly_type :=
  match nth_error Gamma n with Some t => t | None => poly_var n end.

Lemma type_assignment_E_env :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u : term),
    (forall n, In n (atoms u) -> n < length Gamma) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (E u) (enc (T_of Gamma) u).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u H.
  apply type_assignment_E.
  intros n Hn.
  unfold T_of.
  destruct (nth_error Gamma n) as [t|] eqn:E'.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply nth_error_None in E'. exfalso. apply (Nat.lt_irrefl n).
    eapply Nat.lt_le_trans.
    + apply H. exact Hn.
    + exact E'.
Qed.
