From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction.

(* --- Auxiliary semi-unification substitution lemmas --- *)

Definition square_atom (n : nat) : term := arr (atom n) (atom n).

Fixpoint square_term (t : term) : term :=
  match t with
  | atom n => square_atom n
  | arr u v => arr (square_term u) (square_term v)
  end.

Lemma substitute_substitute : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute g (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => substitute g (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f g t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_square_term : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute f (square_term t) = substitute (fun n => arr (f n) (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_ext : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> substitute f t = substitute g t.
Proof.
  intros f g t H; induction t; simpl; [apply H|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma square_term_arr : forall (u : term), exists a b, square_term u = arr a b.
Proof.
  intros u; destruct u; simpl.
  - exists (atom n), (atom n); reflexivity.
  - exists (square_term u1), (square_term u2); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_inj : forall (t u : term), square_term t = square_term u -> t = u.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | t1 IH1 t2 IH2]; intros [m | u v] H; simpl in H.
  - injection H as H1 _. subst. reflexivity.
  - destruct (square_term_arr u) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite <- H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - destruct (square_term_arr t1) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - injection H as H1 H2. subst.
    rewrite (IH1 u H1), (IH2 v H2). reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma square_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  square_term (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => square_term (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_as_subst : forall (t : term),
  square_term t = substitute (fun n => arr (atom n) (atom n)) t.
Proof.
  intros t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.


(* --- Shifting a solution (renaming all image atoms up by one) --- *)

Definition shift_term (t : term) : term := substitute (fun n => atom (S n)) t.
Definition shift_val (f : valuation) : valuation := fun n => shift_term (f n).
Definition up_val (g : valuation) : valuation :=
  fun n => match n with 0 => atom 0 | S k => shift_term (g k) end.

Lemma shift_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  shift_term (substitute f t) = substitute (shift_val f) t.
Proof.
  intros f t. unfold shift_term, shift_val. rewrite substitute_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_up_shift : forall (g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute (up_val g) (shift_term t) = shift_term (substitute g t).
Proof.
  intros g t. unfold shift_term.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  apply substitute_ext; intro n.
  unfold up_val. simpl. unfold shift_term. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_solution : forall (phi psi0 psi1 : valuation) (s t0 t1 : term),
  substitute psi0 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t0 ->
  substitute psi1 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t1 ->
  substitute (up_val psi0) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t0 /\
  substitute (up_val psi1) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t1.
Proof.
  intros phi psi0 psi1 s t0 t1 H0 H1. split.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H0.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H1.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Basic System F typing of combinators --- *)

Lemma type_assignment_I : forall (Gamma : environment) (s : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_var 0)) (poly_arr s s).
Proof.
  intros Gamma s.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_K : forall (Gamma : environment) (a b : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_abs (pure_var 1))) (poly_arr a (poly_arr b a)).
Proof.
  intros Gamma a b.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Type-level renaming lemmas --- *)

Lemma ren_poly_type_ext : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  (forall n, xi n = xj n) -> ren_poly_type xi T = ren_poly_type xj T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj H; simpl.
  - now rewrite H.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj H), (IHb xi xj H).
  - f_equal.
    assert (Hup : forall n, scons 0 (funcomp S xi) n = scons 0 (funcomp S xj) n).
    { intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|]; unfold funcomp; simpl; now rewrite H. }
    rewrite (IHc _ _ Hup). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_poly_type_comp : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  ren_poly_type xi (ren_poly_type xj T) =
  ren_poly_type (fun n => xi (xj n)) T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj), (IHb xi xj).
  - f_equal.
    rewrite (IHc (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons 0 (funcomp S xj))).
    apply ren_poly_type_ext. intro n. destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity|].
    unfold funcomp; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* --- Bridge between term-level and type-level syntax --- *)

Fixpoint encode_term (t : term) : poly_type :=
  match t with
  | atom n => poly_var n
  | arr s t => poly_arr (encode_term s) (encode_term t)
  end.

Lemma encode_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute f t) =
  subst_poly_type (fun n => encode_term (f n)) (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma encode_ren : forall (xi : nat -> nat) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute (fun n => atom (xi n)) t) =
  ren_poly_type xi (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intros xi t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma encode_shift : forall (t : term),
  encode_term (shift_term t) = ren_poly_type S (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intro t. unfold shift_term. apply encode_ren.
Qed.

(* --- Facts about LU2SemiU used to analyse the problem --- *)

Lemma substitute_id : forall (t : term),
  substitute (fun n => atom n) t = t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma no_self_arrow : forall (psi : valuation) (x : term),
  x <> arr (substitute psi x) (substitute psi x).
Proof.
  intros psi x. induction x as [n | a IHa b IHb]; simpl in *.
  - discriminate.
  - intro H. injection H as H1 H2.
    assert (Heq : a = b).
    { transitivity (arr (substitute psi a) (substitute psi b)).
      - exact H1.
      - symmetry. exact H2. }
    subst b. apply (IHa). exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma occurs_unsolvable :
  ~ LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 0), atom 0, atom 0).
Proof.
  intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]].
  simpl in H0.
  apply (no_self_arrow psi0 (phi 0)).
  symmetry. exact H0.
Qed.

Lemma LU2SemiU_atom : forall (n : nat) (t0 t1 : term),
  LU2SemiU (atom n, t0, t1).
Proof.
  intros n t0 t1.
  exists (fun m => atom m).
  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t0 | right _ => atom m end).
  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t1 | right _ => atom m end).
  split.
  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma LU2SemiU_matching :
  forall p,
  LU2SemiU p <->
  (exists phi,
     (exists psi0, substitute psi0 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd (fst p))) /\
     (exists psi1, substitute psi1 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd p))).
Proof.
  intros [[s t0] t1]. simpl.
  split.
  - intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]]. exists phi. split; eauto.
  - intros [phi [[psi0 H0] [psi1 H1]]]. exists phi, psi0, psi1. auto.
Qed.

Definition phi_arrow : valuation := fun n =>
  match n with
  | 0 => atom 0
  | 1 => atom 1
  | 2 => arr (atom 0) (atom 1)
  | S (S (S k)) => atom (S (S (S k)))
  end.

Lemma solvable_arrow_image :
  LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 1), atom 2, atom 2).
Proof.
  exists phi_arrow, (fun n => atom n), (fun n => atom n).
  split.
  - unfold phi_arrow. cbn. reflexivity.
  - unfold phi_arrow. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A solution cannot always be taken with phi mapping atoms to atoms. *)
Lemma no_renaming_solution :
  forall (g : nat -> nat) (psi0 : valuation),
    substitute psi0 (substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (arr (atom 0) (atom 1)))
    <> substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (atom 2).
Proof.
  intros g psi0. simpl. discriminate.
Qed.

(* --- The polymorphic escape in the supplied System F rules --- *)

Lemma type_assignment_xx :
  type_assignment (@nil poly_type)
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)))
    (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)).
Proof.
  refine (@type_assignment_abs nil
            (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))
            (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1) _).
  refine (@type_assignment_app (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
            (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)
            (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1) _ _).
  - refine (@type_assignment_inst (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
              (pure_var 0) (poly_var 0)
              (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)) _).
    apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
  - apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Inductive app_only : pure_term -> Prop :=
| app_only_var (x : nat) : app_only (pure_var x)
| app_only_app (M N : pure_term) : app_only M -> app_only N -> app_only (pure_app M N).

Fixpoint pvar_bound (M : pure_term) : nat :=
  match M with
  | pure_var x => S x
  | pure_app M N => Nat.max (pvar_bound M) (pvar_bound N)
  | pure_abs M => pvar_bound M
  end.

Lemma app_only_typable_aux :
  forall (M : pure_term), app_only M ->
  forall (Gamma : environment) (tau : poly_type) (n : nat),
    pvar_bound M <= n ->
    (forall x, x < n -> nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0))) ->
    type_assignment Gamma M tau.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [x | M N HM IHm HN IHn]; intros Gamma tau n Hb Hl.
  - refine (@type_assignment_inst Gamma (pure_var x) (poly_var 0) tau _).
    apply type_assignment_var.
    apply Hl. unfold pvar_bound in Hb. lia.
  - simpl in Hb.
    assert (Hb1 : pvar_bound M <= n) by (eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_l | exact Hb]).
    assert (Hb2 : pvar_bound N <= n) by (eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_r | exact Hb]).
    refine (@type_assignment_app Gamma M N tau tau _ _).
    + apply (IHm Gamma (poly_arr tau tau) n Hb1 Hl).
    + apply (IHn Gamma tau n Hb2 Hl).
Qed.

Lemma app_only_example : forall tau,
  type_assignment (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3)
    (pure_app (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 1)) (pure_var 2)) tau.
Proof.
  intros tau.
  refine (@app_only_typable_aux _ _ (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3) tau 3 _ _).
  - apply app_only_app.
    + apply app_only_app; constructor.
    + constructor.
  - simpl. lia.
  - intros x Hx.
    destruct x as [|[|[|x]]]; simpl in *; try reflexivity; lia.
Qed.

(* --- square_term does not preserve LU2SemiU solvability --- *)

Definition t_ex : term := arr (atom 0) (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)).

Lemma original_ex_solvable : LU2SemiU (atom 1, t_ex, t_ex).

(* --- Environment insertion and term lifting --- *)

Fixpoint insert_env (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) : environment :=
  match k with
  | 0 => X :: Gamma
  | S k' =>
      match Gamma with
      | nil => X :: nil
      | Y :: Gamma' => Y :: insert_env k' X Gamma'
      end
  end.

Fixpoint lift (k : nat) (M : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  match M with
  | pure_var n => pure_var (if n <? k then n else S n)
  | pure_app M N => pure_app (lift k M) (lift k N)
  | pure_abs M => pure_abs (lift (S k) M)
  end.

Lemma nth_error_insert_lt :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> x < k ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) x = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hlt.
  - lia.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * reflexivity.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_insert_ge :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> k <= x ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) (S x) = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hge.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * lia.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma map_insert_env :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment),
    map (ren_poly_type S) (insert_env k X Gamma) =
    insert_env k (ren_poly_type S X) (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma).
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + now rewrite IH.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_lift :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (tau : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma M tau ->
    forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type),
      type_assignment (insert_env k X Gamma) (lift k M) tau.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M tau H. induction H; intros k X; simpl.
  - apply type_assignment_var.
    destruct (x <? k) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_lt k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_ge k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
  - eapply type_assignment_app; [apply IHtype_assignment1 | apply IHtype_assignment2].
  - apply type_assignment_abs.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment (S k) X).
    exact IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_inst. apply IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_gen.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment k (ren_poly_type S X)).
    rewrite map_insert_env.
    exact IHtype_assignment.
Qed.

(* --- A gadget whose type is forced to be the arrow of two subterm types --- *)

Definition gadget (u v : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                        (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
    (pure_abs (lift 0 v)).

Lemma type_assignment_gadget :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u v : pure_term) (A B : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma u A ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (gadget u v) (poly_arr A B).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u v A B Hu Hv. unfold gadget.
  assert (Harg : type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (lift 0 v)) (poly_arr A B)).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma v B Hv 0 A). }
  assert (Hfun :
    type_assignment Gamma
      (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                          (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
      (poly_arr (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B))).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    simpl.
    refine (@type_assignment_app ((poly_arr A B) :: Gamma)
              (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
              (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))
              B (poly_arr A B) _ _).
    - apply type_assignment_abs.
      apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
    - refine (@type_assignment_app ((poly_arr A B) :: Gamma)
                (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u) A B _ _).
      + apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
      + exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma u A Hu 0 (poly_arr A B)).
  }
  refine (@type_assignment_app Gamma
            (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                                (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
            (pure_abs (lift 0 v))
            (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B) _ _).
  - exact Hfun.
  - exact Harg.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction.

(* --- Auxiliary semi-unification substitution lemmas --- *)

Definition square_atom (n : nat) : term := arr (atom n) (atom n).

Fixpoint square_term (t : term) : term :=
  match t with
  | atom n => square_atom n
  | arr u v => arr (square_term u) (square_term v)
  end.

Lemma substitute_substitute : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute g (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => substitute g (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f g t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_square_term : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute f (square_term t) = substitute (fun n => arr (f n) (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_ext : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> substitute f t = substitute g t.
Proof.
  intros f g t H; induction t; simpl; [apply H|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma square_term_arr : forall (u : term), exists a b, square_term u = arr a b.
Proof.
  intros u; destruct u; simpl.
  - exists (atom n), (atom n); reflexivity.
  - exists (square_term u1), (square_term u2); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_inj : forall (t u : term), square_term t = square_term u -> t = u.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | t1 IH1 t2 IH2]; intros [m | u v] H; simpl in H.
  - injection H as H1 _. subst. reflexivity.
  - destruct (square_term_arr u) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite <- H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - destruct (square_term_arr t1) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - injection H as H1 H2. subst.
    rewrite (IH1 u H1), (IH2 v H2). reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma square_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  square_term (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => square_term (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_as_subst : forall (t : term),
  square_term t = substitute (fun n => arr (atom n) (atom n)) t.
Proof.
  intros t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.


(* --- Shifting a solution (renaming all image atoms up by one) --- *)

Definition shift_term (t : term) : term := substitute (fun n => atom (S n)) t.
Definition shift_val (f : valuation) : valuation := fun n => shift_term (f n).
Definition up_val (g : valuation) : valuation :=
  fun n => match n with 0 => atom 0 | S k => shift_term (g k) end.

Lemma shift_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  shift_term (substitute f t) = substitute (shift_val f) t.
Proof.
  intros f t. unfold shift_term, shift_val. rewrite substitute_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_up_shift : forall (g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute (up_val g) (shift_term t) = shift_term (substitute g t).
Proof.
  intros g t. unfold shift_term.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  apply substitute_ext; intro n.
  unfold up_val. simpl. unfold shift_term. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_solution : forall (phi psi0 psi1 : valuation) (s t0 t1 : term),
  substitute psi0 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t0 ->
  substitute psi1 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t1 ->
  substitute (up_val psi0) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t0 /\
  substitute (up_val psi1) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t1.
Proof.
  intros phi psi0 psi1 s t0 t1 H0 H1. split.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H0.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H1.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Basic System F typing of combinators --- *)

Lemma type_assignment_I : forall (Gamma : environment) (s : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_var 0)) (poly_arr s s).
Proof.
  intros Gamma s.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_K : forall (Gamma : environment) (a b : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_abs (pure_var 1))) (poly_arr a (poly_arr b a)).
Proof.
  intros Gamma a b.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Type-level renaming lemmas --- *)

Lemma ren_poly_type_ext : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  (forall n, xi n = xj n) -> ren_poly_type xi T = ren_poly_type xj T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj H; simpl.
  - now rewrite H.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj H), (IHb xi xj H).
  - f_equal.
    assert (Hup : forall n, scons 0 (funcomp S xi) n = scons 0 (funcomp S xj) n).
    { intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|]; unfold funcomp; simpl; now rewrite H. }
    rewrite (IHc _ _ Hup). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_poly_type_comp : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  ren_poly_type xi (ren_poly_type xj T) =
  ren_poly_type (fun n => xi (xj n)) T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj), (IHb xi xj).
  - f_equal.
    rewrite (IHc (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons 0 (funcomp S xj))).
    apply ren_poly_type_ext. intro n. destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity|].
    unfold funcomp; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* --- Bridge between term-level and type-level syntax --- *)

Fixpoint encode_term (t : term) : poly_type :=
  match t with
  | atom n => poly_var n
  | arr s t => poly_arr (encode_term s) (encode_term t)
  end.

Lemma encode_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute f t) =

  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.

Lemma encode_ren : forall (xi : nat -> nat) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute (fun n => atom (xi n)) t) =

Proof.
  intros xi t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.

Lemma encode_shift : forall (t : term),

Lemma LU2SemiU_matching :
  forall p,
  LU2SemiU p <->
  (exists phi,
     (exists psi0, substitute psi0 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd (fst p))) /\

                   = substitute phi (snd p))).

  intros [[s t0] t1]. simpl.
  split.
  - intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]]. exists phi. split; eauto.
  - intros [phi [[psi0 H0] [psi1 H1]]]. exists phi, psi0, psi1. auto.
Qed.

Definition phi_arrow : valuation := fun n =>
  match n with
  | 0 => atom 0
  | 1 => atom 1
  | 2 => arr (atom 0) (atom 1)
  | S (S (S k)) => atom (S (S (S k)))
  end.

Lemma solvable_arrow_image :
  LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 1), atom 2, atom 2).
Proof.
  exists phi_arrow, (fun n => atom n), (fun n => atom n).
  split.
  - unfold phi_arrow. cbn. reflexivity.
  - unfold phi_arrow. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A solution cannot always be taken with phi mapping atoms to atoms. *)

  forall (g : nat -> nat) (psi0 : valuation),
    substitute psi0 (substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (arr (atom 0) (atom 1)))
    <> substitute (fun n => atom (g n)) (atom 2).
Proof.
  intros g psi0. simpl. discriminate.
Qed.

  type_assignment (@nil poly_type)
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)))
    (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)).
Proof.

            (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))
            (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1) _).
  refine (@type_assignment_app (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
            (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0)
            (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1) _ _).
  - refine (@type_assignment_inst (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
              (pure_var 0) (poly_var 0)
              (poly_arr (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) (poly_var 1)) _).
    apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
  - apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Inductive app_only : pure_term -> Prop :=
| app_only_var (x : nat) : app_only (pure_var x)
| app_only_app (M N : pure_term) : app_only M -> app_only N -> app_only (pure_app M N).

Fixpoint pvar_bound (M : pure_term) : nat :=
  match M with
  | pure_var x => S x
  | pure_app M N => Nat.max (pvar_bound M) (pvar_bound N)
  | pure_abs M => pvar_bound M
  end.

Lemma app_only_typable_aux :
  forall (M : pure_term), app_only M ->
  forall (Gamma : environment) (tau : poly_type) (n : nat),
    pvar_bound M <= n ->
    (forall x, x < n -> nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0))) ->
    type_assignment Gamma M tau.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [x | M N HM IHm HN IHn]; intros Gamma tau n Hb Hl.
  - refine (@type_assignment_inst Gamma (pure_var x) (poly_var 0) tau _).
    apply type_assignment_var.
    apply Hl. unfold pvar_bound in Hb. lia.
  - simpl in Hb.
    assert (Hb1 : pvar_bound M <= n) by (eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_l | exact Hb]).
    assert (Hb2 : pvar_bound N <= n) by (eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply Nat.le_max_r | exact Hb]).
    refine (@type_assignment_app Gamma M N tau tau _ _).
    + apply (IHm Gamma (poly_arr tau tau) n Hb1 Hl).
    + apply (IHn Gamma tau n Hb2 Hl).
Qed.

Lemma app_only_example : forall tau,
  type_assignment (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3)
    (pure_app (pure_app (pure_var 0) (pure_var 1)) (pure_var 2)) tau.
Proof.
  intros tau.
  refine (@app_only_typable_aux _ _ (repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 3) tau 3 _ _).
  - apply app_only_app.
    + apply app_only_app; constructor.
    + constructor.
  - simpl. lia.
  - intros x Hx.

Qed.

Proof.

  exists (fun n => match Nat.eq_dec n 1 with left _ => t_ex | right _ => atom n end).

  ~ LU2SemiU (square_term (atom 1), square_term t_ex, square_term t_ex).
Proof.
  intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 _]]]].

(* --- Environment insertion and term lifting --- *)

Fixpoint insert_env (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) : environment :=
  match k with
  | 0 => X :: Gamma
  | S k' =>
      match Gamma with
      | nil => X :: nil
      | Y :: Gamma' => Y :: insert_env k' X Gamma'
      end
  end.

Fixpoint lift (k : nat) (M : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  match M with
  | pure_var n => pure_var (if n <? k then n else S n)
  | pure_app M N => pure_app (lift k M) (lift k N)
  | pure_abs M => pure_abs (lift (S k) M)
  end.

Lemma nth_error_insert_lt :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> x < k ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) x = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hlt.
  - lia.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * reflexivity.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_insert_ge :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> k <= x ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) (S x) = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hge.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * lia.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma map_insert_env :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment),
    map (ren_poly_type S) (insert_env k X Gamma) =
    insert_env k (ren_poly_type S X) (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma).
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + now rewrite IH.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_lift :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (tau : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma M tau ->
    forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type),
      type_assignment (insert_env k X Gamma) (lift k M) tau.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M tau H. induction H; intros k X; simpl.
  - apply type_assignment_var.
    destruct (x <? k) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_lt k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_ge k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
  - eapply type_assignment_app; [apply IHtype_assignment1 | apply IHtype_assignment2].
  - apply type_assignment_abs.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment (S k) X).
    exact IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_inst. apply IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_gen.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment k (ren_poly_type S X)).
    rewrite map_insert_env.
    exact IHtype_assignment.
Qed.

(* --- A gadget whose type is forced to be the arrow of two subterm types --- *)

Definition gadget (u v : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                        (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
    (pure_abs (lift 0 v)).

Lemma type_assignment_gadget :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u v : pure_term) (A B : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma u A ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (gadget u v) (poly_arr A B).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u v A B Hu Hv. unfold gadget.
  assert (Harg : type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (lift 0 v)) (poly_arr A B)).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma v B Hv 0 A). }
  assert (Hfun :
    type_assignment Gamma
      (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                          (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
      (poly_arr (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B))).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    simpl.
    refine (@type_assignment_app ((poly_arr A B) :: Gamma)
              (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
              (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))
              B (poly_arr A B) _ _).
    - apply type_assignment_abs.
      apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
    - refine (@type_assignment_app ((poly_arr A B) :: Gamma)
                (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u) A B _ _).
      + apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
      + exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma u A Hu 0 (poly_arr A B)).
  }
  refine (@type_assignment_app Gamma
            (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                                (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
            (pure_abs (lift 0 v))
            (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B) _ _).
  - exact Hfun.
  - exact Harg.
Qed.

Fixpoint atoms (u : term) : list nat :=
  match u with
  | atom n => n :: nil
  | arr u v => atoms u ++ atoms v
  end.

Fixpoint enc (T : nat -> poly_type) (u : term) : poly_type :=
  match u with
  | atom n => T n
  | arr u v => poly_arr (enc T u) (enc T v)
  end.

Fixpoint E (u : term) : pure_term :=
  match u with
  | atom n => pure_var n
  | arr u v => gadget (E u) (E v)
  end.

  forall (Gamma : environment) (u : term) (T : nat -> poly_type),
    (forall n, In n (atoms u) -> nth_error Gamma n = Some (T n)) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (E u) (enc T u).

  intros Gamma u. induction u as [n | u IHu v IHv]; intros T H.
  - simpl. apply type_assignment_var. apply H. simpl. auto.
  - simpl. apply type_assignment_gadget.
    + apply IHu. intros k Hk. apply H. apply in_app_iff. left. exact Hk.
    + apply IHv. intros k Hk. apply H. apply in_app_iff. right. exact Hk.
Qed.

  match nth_error Gamma n with Some t => t | None => poly_var n end.

  forall (Gamma : environment) (u : term),

  - apply nth_error_None in E'. exfalso. apply (Nat.lt_irrefl n).
    eapply Nat.lt_le_trans.
    + apply H. exact Hn.
    + exact E'.
Qed.

1	From Stdlib Require Import List.
2	
3	(* pure lambda-terms M, N, .. *)
4	Inductive pure_term : Type :=
5	  | pure_var : nat -> pure_term
6	  | pure_app : pure_term -> pure_term -> pure_term
7	  | pure_abs : pure_term -> pure_term.
8	
9	(* polymorphic types s, t, ..*)
10	Inductive poly_type : Type :=
11	  | poly_var : nat -> poly_type
12	  | poly_arr : poly_type -> poly_type -> poly_type
13	  | poly_abs : poly_type -> poly_type.
14	
15	(* system F type environments *)
16	Definition environment := list poly_type.
17	
18	(* function composition *)
19	Definition funcomp {X Y Z} (g : Y -> Z) (f : X -> Y) :=
20	  fun x => g (f x).
21	
22	(* stream cons *)
23	Definition scons {X: Type} (x : X) (xi : nat -> X) :=
24	  fun n => match n with | 0 => x | S n => xi n end.
25	
26	(* polymorphic type variable renaming *)
27	Fixpoint ren_poly_type (xi : nat -> nat) (s : poly_type) : poly_type  :=
28	  match s return poly_type with
29	  | poly_var x => poly_var (xi x)
30	  | poly_arr s t => poly_arr (ren_poly_type xi s) (ren_poly_type xi t)
31	  | poly_abs s => poly_abs (ren_poly_type (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) s)
32	  end.
33	
34	(* polymorphic type variable substitution *)
35	Fixpoint subst_poly_type (sigma : nat -> poly_type) (s : poly_type) : poly_type  :=
36	  match s return poly_type with
37	  | poly_var s => sigma s
38	  | poly_arr s t => poly_arr (subst_poly_type sigma s) (subst_poly_type sigma t)
39	  | poly_abs s => poly_abs (subst_poly_type (scons (poly_var 0) (funcomp (ren_poly_type S) sigma)) s)
40	  end.
41	
42	(*
43	  Curry-style System F Type Assignment predicate
44	  Γ ⊢ M : τ is (type_assignment Γ M τ)
45	*)
46	Inductive type_assignment : environment -> pure_term -> poly_type -> Prop :=
47	| type_assignment_var {Gamma x t} :
48	    nth_error Gamma x = Some t ->
49	    type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x) t
50	| type_assignment_app {Gamma M N s t} :
51	    type_assignment Gamma M (poly_arr s t) -> type_assignment Gamma N s ->
52	    type_assignment Gamma (pure_app M N) t
53	| type_assignment_abs {Gamma M s t} :
54	    type_assignment (s :: Gamma) M t ->
55	    type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs M) (poly_arr s t)
56	| type_assignment_inst {Gamma M s t} :
57	    type_assignment Gamma M (poly_abs s) ->
58	    type_assignment Gamma M (subst_poly_type (scons t poly_var) s)
59	| type_assignment_gen {Gamma M s} :
60	    type_assignment (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma) M s ->
61	    type_assignment Gamma M (poly_abs s).
62	
63	Definition SysF_TYP : pure_term -> Prop :=
64	  fun M => exists Gamma t, type_assignment Gamma M t.
65

3	Inductive term : Set :=
4	  | atom : nat -> term
5	  | arr : term -> term -> term.
6	
7	Definition valuation : Set := nat -> term.
8	
9	(* substitute atoms n of a term t by (f n) *)
10	Fixpoint substitute (f: valuation) (t: term) : term :=
11	  match t with
12	  | atom n => f n
13	  | arr s t => arr (substitute f s) (substitute f t)
14	  end.
15	
16	(* The two inequalities share the same left-hand side s. *)
17	Definition LU2SemiU : term * term * term -> Prop :=
18	  fun '(s, t0, t1) => exists (φ ψ0 ψ1: valuation),
19	    substitute ψ0 (substitute φ s) = substitute φ t0 /\ substitute ψ1 (substitute φ s) = substitute φ t1.
20

1	Definition reduction {X Y} (f : X -> Y) (P : X -> Prop) (Q : Y -> Prop) :=
2	  forall x, P x <-> Q (f x).
3	(* (reduces P Q) means that
4	   there exists a (total, computable, many-one) reduction f from P to Q *)
5	Definition reduces {X Y} (P : X -> Prop) (Q : Y -> Prop) :=
6	  exists f : X -> Y, reduction f P Q.
7	Notation "P ⪯ Q" := (reduces P Q) (at level 70).

1	From Stdlib Require Import List.
2	From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat Lia.
3	Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction.

5	(* --- Auxiliary semi-unification substitution lemmas --- *)

7	Definition square_atom (n : nat) : term := arr (atom n) (atom n).
8	
9	Fixpoint square_term (t : term) : term :=
10	  match t with
11	  | atom n => square_atom n
12	  | arr u v => arr (square_term u) (square_term v)
13	  end.
14	
15	Lemma substitute_substitute : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
16	  substitute g (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => substitute g (f n)) t.
17	Proof.
18	  intros f g t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
19	  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
20	Qed.
21	
22	Lemma substitute_square_term : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
23	  substitute f (square_term t) = substitute (fun n => arr (f n) (f n)) t.
24	Proof.
25	  intros f t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
26	  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
27	Qed.
28	
29	Lemma substitute_ext : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
30	  (forall n, f n = g n) -> substitute f t = substitute g t.
31	Proof.
32	  intros f g t H; induction t; simpl; [apply H|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
33	Qed.
34	
35	Lemma square_term_arr : forall (u : term), exists a b, square_term u = arr a b.
36	Proof.
37	  intros u; destruct u; simpl.
38	  - exists (atom n), (atom n); reflexivity.
39	  - exists (square_term u1), (square_term u2); reflexivity.
40	Qed.
41	
42	Lemma square_term_inj : forall (t u : term), square_term t = square_term u -> t = u.
43	Proof.
44	  induction t as [n | t1 IH1 t2 IH2]; intros [m | u v] H; simpl in H.
45	  - injection H as H1 _. subst. reflexivity.
46	  - destruct (square_term_arr u) as [x [y Hxy]].
47	    injection H as H1 _. rewrite <- H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
48	  - destruct (square_term_arr t1) as [x [y Hxy]].
49	    injection H as H1 _. rewrite H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
50	  - injection H as H1 H2. subst.
51	    rewrite (IH1 u H1), (IH2 v H2). reflexivity.
52	Qed.
53	
54	
55	Lemma square_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
56	  square_term (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => square_term (f n)) t.
57	Proof.
58	  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
59	  - reflexivity.
60	  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
61	Qed.
62	
63	Lemma square_term_as_subst : forall (t : term),
64	  square_term t = substitute (fun n => arr (atom n) (atom n)) t.
65	Proof.
66	  intros t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
67	Qed.
68	
69	
70	(* --- Shifting a solution (renaming all image atoms up by one) --- *)
71	
72	Definition shift_term (t : term) : term := substitute (fun n => atom (S n)) t.
73	Definition shift_val (f : valuation) : valuation := fun n => shift_term (f n).
74	Definition up_val (g : valuation) : valuation :=
75	  fun n => match n with 0 => atom 0 | S k => shift_term (g k) end.
76	
77	Lemma shift_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
78	  shift_term (substitute f t) = substitute (shift_val f) t.
79	Proof.
80	  intros f t. unfold shift_term, shift_val. rewrite substitute_substitute. reflexivity.
81	Qed.
82	
83	Lemma substitute_up_shift : forall (g : valuation) (t : term),
84	  substitute (up_val g) (shift_term t) = shift_term (substitute g t).
85	Proof.
86	  intros g t. unfold shift_term.
87	  rewrite substitute_substitute.
88	  rewrite substitute_substitute.
89	  apply substitute_ext; intro n.
90	  unfold up_val. simpl. unfold shift_term. reflexivity.
91	Qed.
92	
93	Lemma shift_solution : forall (phi psi0 psi1 : valuation) (s t0 t1 : term),
94	  substitute psi0 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t0 ->
95	  substitute psi1 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t1 ->
96	  substitute (up_val psi0) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t0 /\
97	  substitute (up_val psi1) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t1.
98	Proof.
99	  intros phi psi0 psi1 s t0 t1 H0 H1. split.
100	  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
101	    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H0.
102	    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
103	  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
104	    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H1.
105	    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
106	Qed.

111	Lemma type_assignment_I : forall (Gamma : environment) (s : poly_type),
112	  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_var 0)) (poly_arr s s).
113	Proof.
114	  intros Gamma s.
115	  apply type_assignment_abs.
116	  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
117	Qed.

120	  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_abs (pure_var 1))) (poly_arr a (poly_arr b a)).
121	Proof.

123	  apply type_assignment_abs.
124	  apply type_assignment_abs.

132	  (forall n, xi n = xj n) -> ren_poly_type xi T = ren_poly_type xj T.
133	Proof.
134	  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj H; simpl.
135	  - now rewrite H.
136	  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj H), (IHb xi xj H).
137	  - f_equal.
138	    assert (Hup : forall n, scons 0 (funcomp S xi) n = scons 0 (funcomp S xj) n).
139	    { intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|]; unfold funcomp; simpl; now rewrite H. }

141	Qed.

143	Lemma ren_poly_type_comp : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
144	  ren_poly_type xi (ren_poly_type xj T) =
145	  ren_poly_type (fun n => xi (xj n)) T.
146	Proof.

148	  - reflexivity.
149	  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj), (IHb xi xj).
150	  - f_equal.

165	  encode_term (substitute f t) =

(* A variable with env type forall a. a can be assigned ANY type. *)
Lemma inst_bottom_any :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (x : nat) (T : poly_type),
    nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x) T.
Proof.
  intros Gamma x T H.
  refine (@type_assignment_inst Gamma (pure_var x) (poly_var 0) T _).
  apply type_assignment_var. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma inst_bottom_any' :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (x : nat) (T : poly_type),
    nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x) T.
Proof.
  intros Gamma x T H.
  eapply type_assignment_inst.
  apply type_assignment_var. exact H.
Qed.

(* E (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)) really is gadget (var 0) (var 0). *)

    (gadget (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))
    (poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1)).

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction TaskPrefix.

(* A variable with env type forall a. a can be assigned ANY type. *)
Lemma inst_bottom_any :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (x : nat) (T : poly_type),
    nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x) T.
Proof.
  intros Gamma x T H.
  change (type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x)
            (subst_poly_type (scons T poly_var) (poly_var 0))).
  apply type_assignment_inst.
  apply type_assignment_var. exact H.
Qed.

(* E (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)) really is gadget (var 0) (var 0). *)
Lemma E_square_00 :
  E (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)) = gadget (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* The requested spurious typing: the two occurrences of atom 0 get
   independent instantiations, here poly_var 0 and poly_var 1. *)
Lemma spurious_typing :
  type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
    (gadget (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))
    (poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1)).
Proof.
  apply type_assignment_gadget;
    apply inst_bottom_any; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Same thing via the aliasing through E. *)
Lemma spurious_typing_via_E :
  type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
    (E (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)))
    (poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1)).
Proof.
  rewrite E_square_00. apply spurious_typing.
Qed.

(* The two instantiations are genuinely different. *)
Lemma pv0_neq_pv1 : poly_var 0 <> poly_var 1.
Proof. discriminate. Qed.

(* Consequently this type is NOT enc T (arr 0 0) for any single T;
   every such enc type has equal components. *)
Lemma not_enc_square :
  forall T : nat -> poly_type,
    enc T (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)) <> poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1).
Proof.
  intros T H. cbn in H. injection H as H1 H2.
  rewrite <- H1 in H2. discriminate.
Qed.

(* Hence the spurious typing does not come from type_assignment_E with a
   single leaf-type function. *)
Lemma spurious_not_E_uniform :
  ~ (exists T : nat -> poly_type,
       poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1) = enc T (arr (atom 0) (atom 0))).
Proof.
  intros [T H]. apply (not_enc_square T). symmetry. exact H.
Qed.

(* In contrast, with a shared prescribed type the same term is typable at
   T0 -> T0 (an enc type). *)
Lemma shared_typing :

From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction TaskPrefix.

Lemma inst_bottom_any :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (x : nat) (T : poly_type),
    nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x) T.
Proof.
  intros Gamma x T H.
  change (type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x)
            (subst_poly_type (scons T poly_var) (poly_var 0))).
  apply type_assignment_inst.
  apply type_assignment_var. exact H.
Qed.

(* The naive construction from the task prompt. *)
Definition z : term := atom 2.

Definition CHECK (t : term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app (gadget (lift 0 (E t)) (lift 0 (E z))) (pure_var 0).

Definition Mnaive (s t0 t1 : term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app (pure_abs (gadget (CHECK t0) (CHECK t1))) (E s).

Definition Gamma4 : environment :=
  repeat (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) 4.

Definition s_bad : term := arr (atom 0) (atom 0).
Definition t_bad : term := atom 0.

(* Concrete instantiation types used in the spurious typing. *)
Definition A_bad : poly_type := poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1).
Definition B_bad : poly_type := poly_var 2.

Lemma nth_Gamma4_0 : nth_error Gamma4 0 = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0)).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma nth_Gamma4_2 : nth_error Gamma4 2 = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0)).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* E s at the spurious compound type A_bad. *)
Lemma Hs : type_assignment Gamma4 (E s_bad) A_bad.
Proof.
  unfold s_bad, A_bad. cbn.
  apply type_assignment_gadget.
  - apply inst_bottom_any. exact nth_Gamma4_0.
  - apply inst_bottom_any. exact nth_Gamma4_0.
Qed.

(* E t at A_bad (t is atom 0). *)
Lemma Ht_A : type_assignment Gamma4 (E t_bad) A_bad.
Proof.
  unfold t_bad, A_bad. cbn. apply inst_bottom_any. exact nth_Gamma4_0.
Qed.

(* E z at B_bad (z is atom 2). *)
Lemma Hz_B : type_assignment Gamma4 (E z) B_bad.
Proof.
  unfold z, B_bad. cbn. apply inst_bottom_any. exact nth_Gamma4_2.
Qed.

(* Under the binder x : A_bad, each check is typable, with the same
   argument type A_bad for x. *)
Lemma Hcheck :
  forall (t : term),
    type_assignment Gamma4 (E t) A_bad ->
    type_assignment (A_bad :: Gamma4) (CHECK t) B_bad.
Proof.
  intros t Ht.
  unfold CHECK.
  assert (Hfun :
    type_assignment (A_bad :: Gamma4)
      (gadget (lift 0 (E t)) (lift 0 (E z)))
      (poly_arr A_bad B_bad)).
  { apply type_assignment_gadget.
    - change (type_assignment (insert_env 0 A_bad Gamma4)
                (lift 0 (E t)) A_bad).
      eapply type_assignment_lift. apply Ht.
    - change (type_assignment (insert_env 0 A_bad Gamma4)
                (lift 0 (E z)) B_bad).
      eapply type_assignment_lift. apply Hz_B. }

    (poly_arr B_bad B_bad).

    + apply Hcheck. apply Ht_A.
  - exact Hs.

Lemma inst_bottom_any :

Proof.

            (subst_poly_type (scons T poly_var) (poly_var 0))).
  apply type_assignment_inst.
  apply type_assignment_var. exact H.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A type-equality test: from u:B and v:B this term is typable at B.   *)
(* Intended idea: gadget (lift 0 u) y : A -> B and application to y    *)
(* forces A = B, i.e. type(u) = type(v).                               *)
Definition eqtest (u v : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app
    (pure_abs (pure_app (gadget (lift 0 u) (pure_var 0)) (pure_var 0)))
    v.

Lemma eqtest_sound :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u v : pure_term) (B : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma u B ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (eqtest u v) B.
Proof.
  intros Gamma u v B Hu Hv. unfold eqtest.
  eapply type_assignment_app.
  - eapply type_assignment_abs.
    (* in env B :: Gamma, y = var 0 : B *)
    eapply type_assignment_app.
    + (* gadget (lift 0 u) y : B -> B *)
      apply type_assignment_gadget.
      * change (type_assignment (insert_env 0 B Gamma) (lift 0 u) B).
        eapply type_assignment_lift. apply Hu.
      * apply type_assignment_var. cbn. reflexivity.
    + apply type_assignment_var. cbn. reflexivity.
  - exact Hv.
Qed.

(* The naive arrow inversion statement is suspicious: an arrow type of
   gadget u v should have components that are types of u and v.  We test
   whether it is at least consistent for a gen/inst-produced type. *)
Lemma gadget_arrow_direct :
  forall Gamma u v A B,
    type_assignment Gamma u A ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (gadget u v) (poly_arr A B).
Proof. intros. now apply type_assignment_gadget. Qed.

(* A gen/inst-produced arrow type for gadget (var 0) (var 0) over a bottom
   environment: t -> poly_var 0 for arbitrary t.  Both components are
   indeed types of pure_var 0 in that environment. *)
Lemma gadget_gen_inst_example :
  forall (t : poly_type),
    type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
      (gadget (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))
      (poly_arr t (poly_var 0)).
Proof.
  intro t.
  (* gen: move to the shifted environment, then instantiate. *)
  eapply type_assignment_inst with (s := poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1)) (t := t).
  apply type_assignment_gen.
  apply type_assignment_gadget.
  - apply type_assignment_var. cbn. reflexivity.
  - apply type_assignment_var. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Matching components through inst. *)
Lemma gadget_gen_inst_example_components :
  forall (t : poly_type),
    type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil) (pure_var 0) t /\
    type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil) (pure_var 0) (poly_var 0).
Proof.
  intro t. split.
  - apply inst_bottom_any. cbn. reflexivity.
  - apply inst_bottom_any. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Attempt at the general arrow inversion.  We record it as a conjecture
   only in comments; here we prove the easy app/abs skeleton for the
   special term gadget, for use in analysis. *)

(* If a lambda is typed at an arrow type via the abs rule directly. *)
Lemma abs_arrow_direct :
  forall Gamma M A B,
    type_assignment (A :: Gamma) M B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs M) (poly_arr A B).
Proof. intros. now apply type_assignment_abs. Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction TaskPrefix.

(* A variable with env type forall a. a can be assigned ANY type. *)
Lemma inst_bottom_any :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (x : nat) (T : poly_type),
    nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x) T.
Proof.
  intros Gamma x T H.
  change (type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x)
            (subst_poly_type (scons T poly_var) (poly_var 0))).
  apply type_assignment_inst.
  apply type_assignment_var. exact H.
Qed.

(* E (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)) really is gadget (var 0) (var 0). *)
Lemma E_square_00 :
  E (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)) = gadget (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* The requested spurious typing: the two occurrences of atom 0 get
   independent instantiations, here poly_var 0 and poly_var 1. *)
Lemma spurious_typing :
  type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
    (gadget (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))
    (poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1)).
Proof.
  apply type_assignment_gadget;
    apply inst_bottom_any; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Same thing via the aliasing through E. *)
Lemma spurious_typing_via_E :
  type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
    (E (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)))
    (poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1)).
Proof.
  rewrite E_square_00. apply spurious_typing.
Qed.

(* The two instantiations are genuinely different. *)
Lemma pv0_neq_pv1 : poly_var 0 <> poly_var 1.
Proof. discriminate. Qed.

(* Consequently this type is NOT enc T (arr 0 0) for any single T;
   every such enc type has equal components. *)
Lemma not_enc_square :
  forall T : nat -> poly_type,
    enc T (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)) <> poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1).
Proof.
  intros T H. cbn in H. injection H as H1 H2.
  rewrite H1 in H2. discriminate.
Qed.

(* Hence the spurious typing does not come from type_assignment_E with a
   single leaf-type function. *)
Lemma spurious_not_E_uniform :
  ~ (exists T : nat -> poly_type,
       poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1) = enc T (arr (atom 0) (atom 0))).
Proof.
  intros [T H]. apply (not_enc_square T). symmetry. exact H.
Qed.

(* In contrast, with a shared prescribed type the same term is typable at
   T0 -> T0 (an enc type). *)
Lemma shared_typing :
  forall T : nat -> poly_type,
  type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
    (E (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)))
    (poly_arr (T 0) (T 0)).
Proof.
  intros T. rewrite E_square_00.
  apply type_assignment_gadget;
    (apply inst_bottom_any; simpl; reflexivity).
Qed.

(* A type-equality test: from u:B and v:B this term is typable at B.
   The gadget's domain is forced to be the type of the bound y, and
   application to y forces that domain equal to the codomain B. *)
Definition eqtest (u v : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app
    (pure_abs (pure_app (gadget (lift 0 u) (pure_var 0)) (pure_var 0)))
    v.

Lemma eqtest_sound :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u v : pure_term) (B : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma u B ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (eqtest u v) B.
Proof.
  intros Gamma u v B Hu Hv. unfold eqtest.
  eapply type_assignment_app.
  - eapply type_assignment_abs.
    eapply type_assignment_app.
    + (* gadget (lift 0 u) y : B -> B *)
      apply type_assignment_gadget.
      * apply (type_assignment_lift Gamma u B Hu 0 B).
      * apply type_assignment_var. cbn. reflexivity.
    + apply type_assignment_var. cbn. reflexivity.
  - exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma gadget_arrow_direct :
  forall Gamma u v A B,
    type_assignment Gamma u A ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (gadget u v) (poly_arr A B).
Proof. intros. now apply type_assignment_gadget. Qed.

   gadget (var 0) (var 0) in a bottom environment.  Both components are

  forall (t : poly_type),
    type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil)
      (gadget (pure_var 0) (pure_var 0))
      (poly_arr t (poly_var 0)).
Proof.

  eapply type_assignment_inst
    with (s := poly_arr (poly_var 0) (poly_var 1)) (t := t).
  apply type_assignment_gen.
  apply type_assignment_gadget.
  - apply inst_bottom_any. cbn. reflexivity.
  - apply inst_bottom_any. cbn. reflexivity.

  forall (t : poly_type),
    type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil) (pure_var 0) t /\
    type_assignment (poly_abs (poly_var 0) :: nil) (pure_var 0) (poly_var 0).
Proof.
  intro t. split.
  - apply inst_bottom_any. cbn. reflexivity.
  - apply inst_bottom_any. cbn. reflexivity.

    type_assignment Gamma u B ->

Lemma inst_bottom_any :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (x : nat) (T : poly_type),
    nth_error Gamma x = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x) T.
Proof.
  intros Gamma x T H.
  change (type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x)
            (subst_poly_type (scons T poly_var) (poly_var 0))).
  apply type_assignment_inst.
  apply type_assignment_var. exact H.
Qed.

(* A type-equality test: from u:B and v:B this term is typable at B.
   The gadget's domain is forced to be the type of the bound y, and
   application to y forces that domain equal to the codomain B. *)
Definition eqtest (u v : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app
    (pure_abs (pure_app (gadget (lift 0 u) (pure_var 0)) (pure_var 0)))
    v.

Lemma eqtest_sound :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u v : pure_term) (B : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma u B ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (eqtest u v) B.
Proof.
  intros Gamma u v B Hu Hv. unfold eqtest.
  eapply type_assignment_app.
  - eapply type_assignment_abs.
    eapply type_assignment_app.
    + (* gadget (lift 0 u) y : B -> B *)
      apply type_assignment_gadget.
      * apply (type_assignment_lift Gamma u B Hu 0 B).
      * apply type_assignment_var. cbn. reflexivity.
    + apply type_assignment_var. cbn. reflexivity.
  - exact Hv.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction.

(* --- Auxiliary semi-unification substitution lemmas --- *)

Definition square_atom (n : nat) : term := arr (atom n) (atom n).

Fixpoint square_term (t : term) : term :=
  match t with
  | atom n => square_atom n
  | arr u v => arr (square_term u) (square_term v)
  end.

Lemma substitute_substitute : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute g (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => substitute g (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f g t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_square_term : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute f (square_term t) = substitute (fun n => arr (f n) (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_ext : forall (f g : valuation) (t : term),
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> substitute f t = substitute g t.
Proof.
  intros f g t H; induction t; simpl; [apply H|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma square_term_arr : forall (u : term), exists a b, square_term u = arr a b.
Proof.
  intros u; destruct u; simpl.
  - exists (atom n), (atom n); reflexivity.
  - exists (square_term u1), (square_term u2); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_inj : forall (t u : term), square_term t = square_term u -> t = u.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | t1 IH1 t2 IH2]; intros [m | u v] H; simpl in H.
  - injection H as H1 _. subst. reflexivity.
  - destruct (square_term_arr u) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite <- H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - destruct (square_term_arr t1) as [x [y Hxy]].
    injection H as H1 _. rewrite H1 in Hxy. discriminate.
  - injection H as H1 H2. subst.
    rewrite (IH1 u H1), (IH2 v H2). reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma square_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  square_term (substitute f t) = substitute (fun n => square_term (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma square_term_as_subst : forall (t : term),
  square_term t = substitute (fun n => arr (atom n) (atom n)) t.
Proof.
  intros t; induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.


(* --- Shifting a solution (renaming all image atoms up by one) --- *)

Definition shift_term (t : term) : term := substitute (fun n => atom (S n)) t.
Definition shift_val (f : valuation) : valuation := fun n => shift_term (f n).
Definition up_val (g : valuation) : valuation :=
  fun n => match n with 0 => atom 0 | S k => shift_term (g k) end.

Lemma shift_term_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  shift_term (substitute f t) = substitute (shift_val f) t.
Proof.
  intros f t. unfold shift_term, shift_val. rewrite substitute_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma substitute_up_shift : forall (g : valuation) (t : term),
  substitute (up_val g) (shift_term t) = shift_term (substitute g t).
Proof.
  intros g t. unfold shift_term.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  rewrite substitute_substitute.
  apply substitute_ext; intro n.
  unfold up_val. simpl. unfold shift_term. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_solution : forall (phi psi0 psi1 : valuation) (s t0 t1 : term),
  substitute psi0 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t0 ->
  substitute psi1 (substitute phi s) = substitute phi t1 ->
  substitute (up_val psi0) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t0 /\
  substitute (up_val psi1) (substitute (shift_val phi) s) = substitute (shift_val phi) t1.
Proof.
  intros phi psi0 psi1 s t0 t1 H0 H1. split.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H0.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
  - rewrite <- (shift_term_substitute phi s).
    rewrite substitute_up_shift. rewrite H1.
    rewrite shift_term_substitute. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Basic System F typing of combinators --- *)

Lemma type_assignment_I : forall (Gamma : environment) (s : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_var 0)) (poly_arr s s).
Proof.
  intros Gamma s.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_K : forall (Gamma : environment) (a b : poly_type),
  type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (pure_abs (pure_var 1))) (poly_arr a (poly_arr b a)).
Proof.
  intros Gamma a b.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_abs.
  apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* --- Type-level renaming lemmas --- *)

Lemma ren_poly_type_ext : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  (forall n, xi n = xj n) -> ren_poly_type xi T = ren_poly_type xj T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj H; simpl.
  - now rewrite H.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj H), (IHb xi xj H).
  - f_equal.
    assert (Hup : forall n, scons 0 (funcomp S xi) n = scons 0 (funcomp S xj) n).
    { intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|]; unfold funcomp; simpl; now rewrite H. }
    rewrite (IHc _ _ Hup). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_poly_type_comp : forall (T : poly_type) (xi xj : nat -> nat),
  ren_poly_type xi (ren_poly_type xj T) =
  ren_poly_type (fun n => xi (xj n)) T.
Proof.
  induction T as [n | a IHa b IHb | c IHc]; intros xi xj; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite (IHa xi xj), (IHb xi xj).
  - f_equal.
    rewrite (IHc (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons 0 (funcomp S xj))).
    apply ren_poly_type_ext. intro n. destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity|].
    unfold funcomp; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* --- Bridge between term-level and type-level syntax --- *)

Fixpoint encode_term (t : term) : poly_type :=
  match t with
  | atom n => poly_var n
  | arr s t => poly_arr (encode_term s) (encode_term t)
  end.

Lemma encode_substitute : forall (f : valuation) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute f t) =
  subst_poly_type (fun n => encode_term (f n)) (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intros f t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma encode_ren : forall (xi : nat -> nat) (t : term),
  encode_term (substitute (fun n => atom (xi n)) t) =
  ren_poly_type xi (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intros xi t; induction t; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - now rewrite IHt1, IHt2.
Qed.

Lemma encode_shift : forall (t : term),
  encode_term (shift_term t) = ren_poly_type S (encode_term t).
Proof.
  intro t. unfold shift_term. apply encode_ren.
Qed.

(* --- Facts about LU2SemiU used to analyse the problem --- *)

Lemma substitute_id : forall (t : term),
  substitute (fun n => atom n) t = t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; [reflexivity|now rewrite IHt1, IHt2].
Qed.

Lemma no_self_arrow : forall (psi : valuation) (x : term),
  x <> arr (substitute psi x) (substitute psi x).
Proof.
  intros psi x. induction x as [n | a IHa b IHb]; simpl in *.
  - discriminate.
  - intro H. injection H as H1 H2.
    assert (Heq : a = b).
    { transitivity (arr (substitute psi a) (substitute psi b)).
      - exact H1.
      - symmetry. exact H2. }
    subst b. apply (IHa). exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma occurs_unsolvable :
  ~ LU2SemiU (arr (atom 0) (atom 0), atom 0, atom 0).
Proof.
  intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]].
  simpl in H0.
  apply (no_self_arrow psi0 (phi 0)).
  symmetry. exact H0.
Qed.

Lemma LU2SemiU_atom : forall (n : nat) (t0 t1 : term),
  LU2SemiU (atom n, t0, t1).
Proof.
  intros n t0 t1.
  exists (fun m => atom m).
  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t0 | right _ => atom m end).
  exists (fun m => match Nat.eq_dec m n with left _ => t1 | right _ => atom m end).
  split.
  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
  - rewrite substitute_id. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec n n) as [e|e]; [|exfalso; apply e; reflexivity].
    rewrite substitute_id. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma LU2SemiU_matching :
  forall p,
  LU2SemiU p <->
  (exists phi,
     (exists psi0, substitute psi0 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd (fst p))) /\
     (exists psi1, substitute psi1 (substitute phi (fst (fst p)))
                   = substitute phi (snd p))).
Proof.
  intros [[s t0] t1]. simpl.
  split.
  - intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 H1]]]]. exists phi. split; eauto.
  - intros [phi [[psi0 H0] [psi1 H1]]]. exists phi, psi0, psi1. auto.

  split.
  - unfold phi_arrow. cbn. reflexivity.
  - unfold phi_arrow. cbn. reflexivity.

(* --- square_term does not preserve LU2SemiU solvability --- *)

Definition t_ex : term := arr (atom 0) (arr (atom 0) (atom 0)).

Lemma original_ex_solvable : LU2SemiU (atom 1, t_ex, t_ex).
Proof.
  exists (fun n => atom n).
  exists (fun n => match Nat.eq_dec n 1 with left _ => t_ex | right _ => atom n end).

  - rewrite substitute_id. unfold t_ex. simpl.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec 1 1) as [e|e].
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply e. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma squared_ex_unsolvable :
  ~ LU2SemiU (square_term (atom 1), square_term t_ex, square_term t_ex).
Proof.
  intros [phi [psi0 [psi1 [H0 _]]]].
  unfold square_term, square_atom, t_ex in H0. simpl in H0.
  injection H0 as H1 H2.
  assert (Hbad : phi 0 = arr (phi 0) (phi 0)).
  { injection (eq_trans (eq_sym H1) H2) as H3 _. exact H3. }
  apply (no_self_arrow (fun n => atom n) (phi 0)).
  rewrite substitute_id. exact Hbad.
Qed.

(* --- Environment insertion and term lifting --- *)

Fixpoint insert_env (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) : environment :=
  match k with
  | 0 => X :: Gamma
  | S k' =>
      match Gamma with
      | nil => X :: nil
      | Y :: Gamma' => Y :: insert_env k' X Gamma'
      end
  end.

Fixpoint lift (k : nat) (M : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  match M with
  | pure_var n => pure_var (if n <? k then n else S n)
  | pure_app M N => pure_app (lift k M) (lift k N)
  | pure_abs M => pure_abs (lift (S k) M)
  end.

Lemma nth_error_insert_lt :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> x < k ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) x = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hlt.
  - lia.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * reflexivity.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_insert_ge :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (x : nat),
    x < length Gamma -> k <= x ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) (S x) = nth_error Gamma x.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma x Hlen Hge.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + destruct x as [|x].
      * lia.
      * simpl. apply IH; [simpl in Hlen; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma map_insert_env :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment),
    map (ren_poly_type S) (insert_env k X Gamma) =
    insert_env k (ren_poly_type S X) (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma).
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros X Gamma; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct Gamma as [|Y Gamma']; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + now rewrite IH.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_lift :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (tau : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma M tau ->
    forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type),
      type_assignment (insert_env k X Gamma) (lift k M) tau.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M tau H. induction H; intros k X; simpl.
  - apply type_assignment_var.
    destruct (x <? k) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_lt k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in E.
      rewrite (nth_error_insert_ge k X Gamma x); [exact H | | exact E].
      apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
  - eapply type_assignment_app; [apply IHtype_assignment1 | apply IHtype_assignment2].
  - apply type_assignment_abs.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment (S k) X).
    exact IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_inst. apply IHtype_assignment.
  - apply type_assignment_gen.
    specialize (IHtype_assignment k (ren_poly_type S X)).
    rewrite map_insert_env.
    exact IHtype_assignment.
Qed.

(* --- A gadget whose type is forced to be the arrow of two subterm types --- *)

Definition gadget (u v : pure_term) : pure_term :=
  pure_app
    (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                        (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
    (pure_abs (lift 0 v)).

Lemma type_assignment_gadget :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u v : pure_term) (A B : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma u A ->
    type_assignment Gamma v B ->
    type_assignment Gamma (gadget u v) (poly_arr A B).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u v A B Hu Hv. unfold gadget.
  assert (Harg : type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs (lift 0 v)) (poly_arr A B)).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma v B Hv 0 A). }
  assert (Hfun :
    type_assignment Gamma
      (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                          (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
      (poly_arr (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B))).
  { apply type_assignment_abs.
    simpl.
    refine (@type_assignment_app ((poly_arr A B) :: Gamma)
              (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
              (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))
              B (poly_arr A B) _ _).
    - apply type_assignment_abs.
      apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
    - refine (@type_assignment_app ((poly_arr A B) :: Gamma)
                (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u) A B _ _).
      + apply type_assignment_var. simpl. reflexivity.
      + exact (type_assignment_lift Gamma u A Hu 0 (poly_arr A B)).
  }
  refine (@type_assignment_app Gamma
            (pure_abs (pure_app (pure_abs (pure_var 1))
                                (pure_app (pure_var 0) (lift 0 u))))
            (pure_abs (lift 0 v))
            (poly_arr A B) (poly_arr A B) _ _).
  - exact Hfun.
  - exact Harg.
Qed.

(* --- Encoding semi-unification terms as System F types via the gadget --- *)

Fixpoint atoms (u : term) : list nat :=
  match u with
  | atom n => n :: nil
  | arr u v => atoms u ++ atoms v
  end.

Fixpoint enc (T : nat -> poly_type) (u : term) : poly_type :=
  match u with
  | atom n => T n
  | arr u v => poly_arr (enc T u) (enc T v)
  end.

Fixpoint E (u : term) : pure_term :=
  match u with
  | atom n => pure_var n
  | arr u v => gadget (E u) (E v)
  end.

Lemma type_assignment_E :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u : term) (T : nat -> poly_type),
    (forall n, In n (atoms u) -> nth_error Gamma n = Some (T n)) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (E u) (enc T u).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u. induction u as [n | u IHu v IHv]; intros T H.
  - simpl. apply type_assignment_var. apply H. simpl. auto.
  - simpl. apply type_assignment_gadget.
    + apply IHu. intros k Hk. apply H. apply in_app_iff. left. exact Hk.
    + apply IHv. intros k Hk. apply H. apply in_app_iff. right. exact Hk.
Qed.

Definition T_of (Gamma : environment) (n : nat) : poly_type :=
  match nth_error Gamma n with Some t => t | None => poly_var n end.

Lemma type_assignment_E_env :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (u : term),
    (forall n, In n (atoms u) -> n < length Gamma) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (E u) (enc (T_of Gamma) u).
Proof.
  intros Gamma u H.
  apply type_assignment_E.
  intros n Hn.
  unfold T_of.
  destruct (nth_error Gamma n) as [t|] eqn:E'.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply nth_error_None in E'. exfalso. apply (Nat.lt_irrefl n).
    eapply Nat.lt_le_trans.
    + apply H. exact Hn.
    + exact E'.
Qed.

Lemma type_assignment_E_bottom :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (T : nat -> poly_type) (u : term),
    (forall n, In n (atoms u) -> nth_error Gamma n = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0))) ->
    type_assignment Gamma (E u) (enc T u).
Proof.
  intros Gamma T u. induction u as [n | u IHu v IHv]; intros H.
  - simpl.
    refine (@type_assignment_inst Gamma (pure_var n) (poly_var 0) (T n) _).
    apply type_assignment_var. apply H. simpl. auto.
  - simpl. apply type_assignment_gadget.
    + apply IHu. intros k Hk. apply H. apply in_app_iff. left. exact Hk.
    + apply IHv. intros k Hk. apply H. apply in_app_iff. right. exact Hk.
Qed.

Lemma bottom_insert :
  forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (n : nat),
    nth_error Gamma n = Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0)) ->
    nth_error (insert_env k X Gamma) (if n <? k then n else S n) =
      Some (poly_abs (poly_var 0)).
Proof.
  intros k X Gamma n H.
  destruct (n <? k) eqn:E.
  - apply Nat.ltb_lt in E.
    rewrite nth_error_insert_lt; [exact H | | exact E].
    apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
  - apply Nat.ltb_ge in E.
    rewrite nth_error_insert_ge; [exact H | | exact E].
    apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate.
Qed.

    vtype Gamma x T C -> nth_error Gamma x = Some T.
Proof. intros Gamma x T C H. induction H; assumption. Qed.

Lemma vtype_sound :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (x : nat) (T C : poly_type),
    vtype Gamma x T C -> type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x) C.
Proof.
  intros Gamma x T C H. induction H.
  - apply type_assignment_var. exact H.
  - apply type_assignment_gen. exact IHvtype.
  - refine (@type_assignment_inst Gamma (pure_var x) U V _).
    exact IHvtype.
Qed.

Lemma vtype_complete :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (C : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma M C ->
    forall (x : nat), M = pure_var x ->
    exists T, vtype Gamma x T C.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M C H. induction H; intros x Heq.
  - injection Heq as Hx. subst. exists t. apply vtype_var. exact H.
  - simpl in Heq. discriminate.
  - simpl in Heq. discriminate.
  - (* inst *) apply IHtype_assignment in Heq. destruct Heq as [T HT].
    exists T. refine (@vtype_inst Gamma x T s t _). exact HT.
  - (* gen *) apply IHtype_assignment in Heq. destruct Heq as [T' HT'].
    pose proof (vtype_entry _ _ _ _ HT') as Hentry.
    rewrite nth_error_map in Hentry.
    destruct (nth_error Gamma x) as [T|] eqn:E; simpl in Hentry; try discriminate.
    injection Hentry as HT'.
    exists T. rewrite <- HT'.
    refine (@vtype_gen Gamma x T s E _). exact HT'.
Qed.

(* Every typing of a variable is exactly an instance of this closure. *)
Theorem type_assignment_var_iff :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (x : nat) (C : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x) C <->
    exists T, nth_error Gamma x = Some T /\ vtype Gamma x T C.
Proof.
  intros Gamma x C. split.
  - intro H. destruct (vtype_complete Gamma (pure_var x) C H x eq_refl) as [T HT].
    exists T. split; [apply (vtype_entry _ _ _ _ HT)|exact HT].
  - intros [T [Hn HT]]. exists T in *. (* keep *)
    assert (Hn' : nth_error Gamma x = Some T) by exact Hn.
    clear Hn.
    (* vtype carries its own entry; soundness gives the typing *)
    apply vtype_sound with (T := T). exact HT.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith PeanoNat Lia.
Require Import SysF SemiU Reduction TaskPrefix.

(* Inversion for application-shaped terms: every type of pure_app M N is
   either the result of the application rule (with the actual subterm typings)
   or a gen/inst wrapper around such a type. *)
Inductive apptype : environment -> pure_term -> pure_term -> poly_type -> Prop :=
| apptype_app : forall (Gamma : environment) (M N : pure_term) (A C : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma M (poly_arr A C) ->
    type_assignment Gamma N A ->
    apptype Gamma M N C
| apptype_gen : forall (Gamma : environment) (M N : pure_term) (s : poly_type),
    apptype (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma) M N s ->
    apptype Gamma M N (poly_abs s)
| apptype_inst : forall (Gamma : environment) (M N : pure_term) (U V : poly_type),
    apptype Gamma M N (poly_abs U) ->
    apptype Gamma M N (subst_poly_type (scons V poly_var) U).

Lemma apptype_sound :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M N : pure_term) (C : poly_type),
    apptype Gamma M N C -> type_assignment Gamma (pure_app M N) C.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M N C H. induction H.
  - eapply type_assignment_app; eassumption.
  - apply type_assignment_gen. exact IHapptype.
  - eapply type_assignment_inst. exact IHapptype.
Qed.

Lemma apptype_complete :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M N : pure_term) (C : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_app M N) C -> apptype Gamma M N C.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M N C H. remember (pure_app M N) as T eqn:E.
  revert M N E. induction H; intros M0 N0 E.
  - simpl in E. discriminate.
  - injection E as -> ->. eapply apptype_app; eassumption.
  - simpl in E. discriminate.
  - (* inst *) eapply apptype_inst. eapply IHtype_assignment. reflexivity.
  - (* gen *) eapply apptype_gen. eapply IHtype_assignment. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Inversion for abstraction-shaped terms.  Here abstype Gamma M C means
   Gamma |- pure_abs M : C. *)
Inductive abstype : environment -> pure_term -> poly_type -> Prop :=
| abstype_abs : forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (A B : poly_type),
    type_assignment (A :: Gamma) M B ->
    abstype Gamma M (poly_arr A B)
| abstype_gen : forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (s : poly_type),
    abstype (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma) M s ->
    abstype Gamma M (poly_abs s)
| abstype_inst : forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (U V : poly_type),
    abstype Gamma M (poly_abs U) ->
    abstype Gamma M (subst_poly_type (scons V poly_var) U).

Lemma abstype_sound :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (C : poly_type),
    abstype Gamma M C -> type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs M) C.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M C H. induction H.
  - apply type_assignment_abs. exact H.
  - apply type_assignment_gen. exact IHabstype.
  - eapply type_assignment_inst. exact IHabstype.
Qed.

Lemma abstype_complete :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term) (C : poly_type),
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs M) C -> abstype Gamma M C.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M C H. remember (pure_abs M) as T eqn:E.
  revert M E. induction H; intros M0 E.
  - simpl in E. discriminate.
  - simpl in E. discriminate.

  - (* inst *) eapply abstype_inst. eapply IHtype_assignment. reflexivity.
  - (* gen *) eapply abstype_gen. eapply IHtype_assignment. reflexivity.
Qed.

Check apptype_complete.
Check abstype_sound.
Check abstype_complete.

Lemma fv_ok_app_l :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M N : pure_term),
    fv_ok Gamma (pure_app M N) -> fv_ok Gamma M.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M N Hok n Hn. apply Hok.
  simpl. apply in_app_iff. left. exact Hn.
Qed.

Lemma fv_ok_app_r :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M N : pure_term),
    fv_ok Gamma (pure_app M N) -> fv_ok Gamma N.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M N Hok n Hn. apply Hok.
  simpl. apply in_app_iff. right. exact Hn.
Qed.

Lemma fv_ok_map :
  forall (Gamma : environment) (M : pure_term),
    fv_ok Gamma M -> fv_ok (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma) M.
Proof.
  intros Gamma M Hok n Hn. rewrite length_map. apply Hok. exact Hn.
Qed.

Lemma apptype_lift_inv_gen :
  forall (D : environment) (LM LN : pure_term) (C : poly_type),
    apptype D LM LN C ->
    forall (k : nat) (X : poly_type) (Gamma : environment) (M N : pure_term),
      LM = lift k M ->
      LN = lift k N ->

          type_assignment Gamma N B) ->

    intros k0 X0 Gamma0 M0 N0 ELM ELN ED Hok HM HN.

    + exact ELM.
    + exact ELN.
    + exact ED.
    + exact Hok.
    + exact HM.
    + exact HN.

  forall (D : environment) (LM : pure_term) (C : poly_type),
    abstype D LM C ->

          type_assignment Gamma M B) ->

    + exact Hok.
    + exact HM.
